### Ideogram 4

Ideogram 4 uses a split layout with an extra **unconditional diffusion model** (`uncondModelSrc`) alongside the Qwen3-VL LLM text encoder (`llmModelSrc`) and VAE (`vaeModelSrc`). Unlike the other families, its `prompt` must be a **JSON-serialized structured caption** â€” an object with a `high_level_description`, a `style_description`, and a `compositional_deconstruction` that lays out each element with an explicit bounding box (`bbox`) and, for text elements, the literal `text` to render. Plain-text prompts produce degenerate or placeholder output.

<Callout type="warn">
  Pass the structured caption serialized, not as an object: `JSON.stringify(...)` in JavaScript and TypeScript, or `json.dumps(..., separators=(",", ":"))` in Python, whose default spacing the model does not expect. The bounding boxes are expressed in the target canvas coordinate space (`[x0, y0, x1, y1]`), so keep them consistent with the requested `width`/`height`. Failure to abide by the JSON format specified within the examples, or adding NSFW prompts, will result in censored image output.
</Callout>

The following script loads Ideogram 4 in split-layout (diffusion model + unconditional model + LLM text encoder + VAE) and generates from a structured caption:

<Tabs>
  <Tab value="js" label="JavaScript" default>
    <WrapCode>
      ```js file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk/dist/examples/diffusion-ideogram.js title="diffusion-ideogram.js" lineNumbers
      import { diffusion, loadModel, unloadModel } from '@qvac/sdk';
      import fs from 'fs';
      import path from 'path';
      const diffusionModelSrc = process.argv[2] ||
          'https://huggingface.co/leejet/ideogram-4-GGUF/resolve/main/ideogram4-Q4_0.gguf';
      const uncondModelSrc = process.argv[3] ||
          'https://huggingface.co/leejet/ideogram-4-GGUF/resolve/main/ideogram4_uncond-Q4_0.gguf';
      const llmModelSrc = process.argv[4] ||
          'https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct-GGUF/resolve/main/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf';
      const vaeModelSrc = process.argv[5] ||
          'https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux2-dev/resolve/main/split_files/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors';
      const outputDir = process.argv[6] || '.';
      function formatMb(bytes) {
          return (bytes / 1e6).toFixed(1);
      }
      // Ideogram 4 expects a JSON-serialized structured caption with explicit
      // bounding boxes. Plain-text prompts produce degenerate or placeholder output.
      const structuredPrompt = {
          high_level_description: 'A bright product photo of one yellow coffee mug on a clean office desk with a tiny readable label that says IDEO.',
          style_description: {
              aesthetics: 'simple product photography, clean bright office desk, minimal composition',
              lighting: 'soft studio light with gentle shadows',
              photo: 'sharp focus, crisp readable label text',
              medium: 'product photo',
              color_palette: ['#FFD54A', '#FFFFFF', '#111111', '#7EC8E3']
          },
          compositional_deconstruction: {
              canvas: 'Square canvas, upright orientation. All text is horizontal and readable.',
              background: 'Clean white office desk with a soft blue background gradient.',
              elements: [
                  {
                      type: 'obj',
                      bbox: [230, 260, 800, 740],
                      desc: 'Exactly one matte yellow ceramic coffee mug centered on the desk.'
                  },
                  {
                      type: 'text',
                      bbox: [510, 360, 620, 640],
                      text: 'IDEO',
                      desc: 'Small black label printed horizontally on the mug.'
                  }
              ]
          }
      };
      if (process.argv.includes('--help')) {
          console.log('Usage: tsx examples/diffusion-ideogram.ts [model] [uncond] [llm] [vae] [output-dir]');
          console.log('â–¸ Defaults use the four Hugging Face model URLs supported by the diffusion addon.');
          process.exit(0);
      }
      let modelId;
      try {
          console.log('â–¸ Loading Ideogram 4 split-layout model...');
          modelId = await loadModel({
              modelSrc: diffusionModelSrc,
              modelType: 'sdcpp-generation',
              modelConfig: {
                  device: 'gpu',
                  threads: 4,
                  diffusion_fa: true,
                  offload_to_cpu: true,
                  llmModelSrc,
                  vaeModelSrc,
                  uncondModelSrc
              },
              onProgress: (progress) => {
                  const line = `â–¸ Downloading ${progress.percentage.toFixed(0)}% (${formatMb(progress.downloaded)}/${formatMb(progress.total)} MB)`;
                  process.stderr.write(process.stderr.isTTY ? `\r${line}` : `${line}\n`);
                  if (progress.percentage >= 100)
                      process.stderr.write('\n');
              }
          });
          console.log(`â–¸ Model loaded: ${modelId}`);
          const { progressStream, outputs, stats } = diffusion({
              modelId,
              prompt: JSON.stringify(structuredPrompt),
              width: 768,
              height: 768,
              steps: 16,
              cfg_scale: 7,
              seed: 42
          });
          for await (const { step, totalSteps } of progressStream) {
              console.log(`â–¸ step ${step}/${totalSteps}`);
          }
          const buffers = await outputs;
          for (let i = 0; i < buffers.length; i++) {
              const outputPath = path.join(outputDir, `ideogram_${i}.png`);
              fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, buffers[i]);
              console.log(`â–¸ Saved ${outputPath}`);
          }
          console.log('â–¸ Stats:', await stats);
          await unloadModel({ modelId, clearStorage: false });
          modelId = undefined;
          console.log('â–¸ Done');
          process.exit(0);
      }
      catch (error) {
          if (modelId) {
              try {
                  await unloadModel({ modelId, clearStorage: false });
              }
              catch {
                  // Preserve the original error.
              }
          }
          console.error('âœ–', error);
          process.exit(1);
      }
      ```

      ```python file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk-python/examples/diffusion_ideogram.py title="diffusion_ideogram.py" lineNumbers
      """Python port of packages/sdk/examples/diffusion-ideogram.ts.

      Ideogram 4 in split layout: a diffusion model, an unconditional diffusion
      model, a Qwen3-VL LLM text encoder and a VAE, all handed to one `load_model`
      call. Its `prompt` is not prose but a serialized structured caption, with a
      bounding box per element in the target canvas coordinate space.

      Two Python-specific details. `json.dumps` pads with spaces by default while
      `JSON.stringify` emits none, so `separators` keeps the serialized caption
      byte-identical to what the TypeScript example sends -- the model is sensitive
      to this format. And `diffusion_stream` is one iterator where TypeScript's
      `diffusion()` returns separate progress, output and stats channels, so the
      loop below splits them apart.

      RUN: python examples/diffusion_ideogram.py [model] [uncond] [llm] [vae] [output-dir]
      """

      from __future__ import annotations

      import asyncio
      import base64
      import contextlib
      import json
      import sys
      from pathlib import Path

      from tetherto.qvac_sdk import (
          Client,
          DiffusionStreamRequest,
          diffusion_stream,
          load_model,
          unload_model,
      )

      DIFFUSION_MODEL_SRC = (
          "https://huggingface.co/leejet/ideogram-4-GGUF/resolve/main/ideogram4-Q4_0.gguf"
      )
      UNCOND_MODEL_SRC = "https://huggingface.co/leejet/ideogram-4-GGUF/resolve/main/ideogram4_uncond-Q4_0.gguf"
      LLM_MODEL_SRC = "https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct-GGUF/resolve/main/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf"
      VAE_MODEL_SRC = "https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux2-dev/resolve/main/split_files/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors"

      # Ideogram 4 expects a JSON-serialized structured caption with explicit
      # bounding boxes. Plain-text prompts produce degenerate or placeholder output.
      STRUCTURED_PROMPT = {
          "high_level_description": "A bright product photo of one yellow coffee mug on a clean office desk with a tiny readable label that says IDEO.",
          "style_description": {
              "aesthetics": "simple product photography, clean bright office desk, minimal composition",
              "lighting": "soft studio light with gentle shadows",
              "photo": "sharp focus, crisp readable label text",
              "medium": "product photo",
              "color_palette": ["#FFD54A", "#FFFFFF", "#111111", "#7EC8E3"],
          },
          "compositional_deconstruction": {
              "canvas": "Square canvas, upright orientation. All text is horizontal and readable.",
              "background": "Clean white office desk with a soft blue background gradient.",
              "elements": [
                  {
                      "type": "obj",
                      "bbox": [230, 260, 800, 740],
                      "desc": "Exactly one matte yellow ceramic coffee mug centered on the desk.",
                  },
                  {
                      "type": "text",
                      "bbox": [510, 360, 620, 640],
                      "text": "IDEO",
                      "desc": "Small black label printed horizontally on the mug.",
                  },
              ],
          },
      }


      def print_progress(p) -> None:
          """Print model download progress; pass as `on_progress=` to `load_model`."""
          line = (
              f"â–¸ Downloading {p.percentage:.0f}% "
              f"({p.downloaded / 1e6:.1f}/{p.total / 1e6:.1f} MB)"
          )
          print(line, end="\r" if sys.stderr.isatty() else "\n", file=sys.stderr)
          if p.percentage >= 100:
              print(file=sys.stderr)


      async def main() -> int:
          if "--help" in sys.argv:
              print(
                  "Usage: python examples/diffusion_ideogram.py "
                  "[model] [uncond] [llm] [vae] [output-dir]"
              )
              print(
                  "â–¸ Defaults use the four Hugging Face model URLs supported by the "
                  "diffusion addon."
              )
              return 0

          diffusion_model_src = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else DIFFUSION_MODEL_SRC
          uncond_model_src = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else UNCOND_MODEL_SRC
          llm_model_src = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else LLM_MODEL_SRC
          vae_model_src = sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) > 4 else VAE_MODEL_SRC
          output_dir = Path(sys.argv[5]) if len(sys.argv) > 5 else Path(".")

          async with Client() as client:
              t = client.transport
              model_id = None

              try:
                  print("â–¸ Loading Ideogram 4 split-layout model...")
                  model_id = await load_model(
                      t,
                      model_src=diffusion_model_src,
                      model_type="sdcpp-generation",
                      model_config={
                          "device": "gpu",
                          "threads": 4,
                          "diffusion_fa": True,
                          "offload_to_cpu": True,
                          "llmModelSrc": llm_model_src,
                          "vaeModelSrc": vae_model_src,
                          "uncondModelSrc": uncond_model_src,
                      },
                      on_progress=print_progress,
                  )
                  print(f"â–¸ Model loaded: {model_id}")

                  request = DiffusionStreamRequest.model_validate(
                      {
                          "type": "diffusionStream",
                          "modelId": model_id,
                          # Compact separators match JSON.stringify; the model is
                          # sensitive to the caption's exact format.
                          "prompt": json.dumps(STRUCTURED_PROMPT, separators=(",", ":")),
                          "width": 768,
                          "height": 768,
                          "steps": 16,
                          "cfg_scale": 7,
                          "seed": 42,
                      }
                  )

                  images: list[bytes] = []
                  stats = None
                  async for response in diffusion_stream(t, request):
                      if response.step is not None and response.total_steps is not None:
                          print(f"â–¸ step {response.step:.0f}/{response.total_steps:.0f}")
                      if response.data is not None:
                          images.append(base64.b64decode(response.data))
                      if response.done:
                          stats = response.stats

                  for index, image in enumerate(images):
                      output_path = output_dir / f"ideogram_{index}.png"
                      output_path.write_bytes(image)
                      print(f"â–¸ Saved {output_path}")

                  print("â–¸ Stats:", stats.model_dump(exclude_none=True) if stats else None)

                  await unload_model(t, model_id)
                  model_id = None
                  print("â–¸ Done")
              except Exception as error:
                  if model_id is not None:
                      # Preserve the original error.
                      with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                          await unload_model(t, model_id)
                  print("âœ–", error, file=sys.stderr)
                  return 1

          return 0


      if __name__ == "__main__":
          sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))
      ```

### Stable Diffusion

The following script shows a minimal text-to-image generation example using a single all-in-one SD 2.1 model:

<Tabs>

      ```js file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk/dist/examples/diffusion-simple.js title="diffusion-simple.js" lineNumbers
      import { loadModel, unloadModel, diffusion, SD_V2_1_1B_Q8_0 } from '@qvac/sdk';
      import fs from 'fs';
      // Minimal diffusion example â€” single GGUF model, no companion files needed.
      // Works with SD 1.x / 2.x all-in-one models.
      const modelSrc = process.argv[2] || SD_V2_1_1B_Q8_0;
      const prompt = process.argv[3] || 'a photo of a cat sitting on a windowsill';
      const modelId = await loadModel({
          modelSrc,
          modelType: 'sdcpp-generation',
          modelConfig: { prediction: 'v' }
      });
      const { outputs } = diffusion({ modelId, prompt });
      const buffers = await outputs;
      fs.writeFileSync('output.png', buffers[0]);
      console.log('â–¸ Saved output.png');
      await unloadModel({ modelId, clearStorage: false });
      process.exit(0);
      ```

  <Tab value="python" label="Python">
    <WrapCode>
      ```python file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk-python/examples/diffusion_simple.py title="diffusion_simple.py" lineNumbers
      """Python port of packages/sdk/examples/diffusion-simple.ts.

      Minimal diffusion example -- single GGUF model, no companion files needed.
      Works with SD 1.x / 2.x all-in-one models.

      TypeScript reads the finished image off the `outputs` promise that
      `diffusion()` returns. Python has only the `diffusion_stream` iterator, so the
      image arrives as a base64 chunk on the stream. Everything else the stream
      carries -- per-step progress, closing stats -- is ignored here, exactly as the
      TypeScript example ignores the channels it does not destructure.

      RUN: python examples/diffusion_simple.py [model-src] [prompt]
      """

      from __future__ import annotations

      import asyncio
      import base64
      import sys
      from pathlib import Path

      from tetherto.qvac_sdk import (
          Client,
          DiffusionStreamRequest,
          diffusion_stream,
          load_model,
          unload_model,
      )
      from tetherto.qvac_sdk.models import SD_V2_1_1B_Q8_0


      async def main() -> int:
          model_src = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else SD_V2_1_1B_Q8_0
          prompt = (
              sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "a photo of a cat sitting on a windowsill"
          )

          async with Client() as client:
              t = client.transport

              model_id = await load_model(
                  t,
                  model_src=model_src,
                  model_type="sdcpp-generation",
                  model_config={"prediction": "v"},
              )

              request = DiffusionStreamRequest.model_validate(
                  {"type": "diffusionStream", "modelId": model_id, "prompt": prompt}
              )

              images: list[bytes] = []
              async for response in diffusion_stream(t, request):
                  if response.data is not None:
                      images.append(base64.b64decode(response.data))

              Path("output.png").write_bytes(images[0])
              print("â–¸ Saved output.png")

              await unload_model(t, model_id)

          return 0


      if __name__ == "__main__":
          sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))
      ```
    </WrapCode>
  </Tab>

### Image-to-image

Pass `init_image` to transform an existing image guided by a text prompt. Behavior depends on the model family:

* **FLUX.2**: in-context conditioning. Requires `prediction: "flux2_flow"` in `modelConfig` at `loadModel()` time; `strength` is ignored on this path.
* **Qwen-Image-2.1** uses reference conditioning with automatic model detection. Supply `projectionModelSrc` at load time for editing with the GGUF encoder. Use `init_image` or ordered `init_images`; `strength` does not control reference fidelity.
* **SD / SDXL / SD3**: SDEdit-style. Use `strength` to control how much the source is preserved (`0` = keep source, `1` = ignore source).

The following script loads FLUX.2-klein in split-layout and transforms an input image using in-context conditioning (`prediction: "flux2_flow"`):

<Tabs>
  <Tab value="js" label="JavaScript" default>
    <WrapCode>
      ```js file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk/dist/examples/diffusion-flux2-klein-img2img.js title="diffusion-flux2-klein-img2img.js" lineNumbers
      import { loadModel, unloadModel, diffusion, FLUX_2_KLEIN_4B_Q4_0, FLUX_2_KLEIN_4B_VAE, QWEN3_4B_Q4_K_M } from '@qvac/sdk';
      import fs from 'fs';
      import path from 'path';
      // img2img with FLUX.2 [klein] split-layout â€” uses in-context conditioning ("flux2_flow").
      const inputPath = process.argv[2];
      const prompt = process.argv[3] || 'oil painting style, vibrant colors';
      const outputDir = process.argv[4] || '.';
      const diffusionModelSrc = process.argv[5] || FLUX_2_KLEIN_4B_Q4_0;

      if (!inputPath) {
          console.error('âœ– input image path is required');

          process.exit(1);

          console.log('â–¸ Loading FLUX.2 [klein] split-layout model...');
          const modelId = await loadModel({
              modelSrc: diffusionModelSrc,
              modelType: 'sdcpp-generation',
              modelConfig: {
                  device: 'gpu',
                  threads: 4,
                  llmModelSrc,
                  vaeModelSrc,
                  prediction: 'flux2_flow'
              },
              onProgress: (p) => {
                  const mb = (n) => (n / 1e6).toFixed(1);
                  const line = `â–¸ Downloading ${p.percentage.toFixed(0)}% (${mb(p.downloaded)}/${mb(p.total)} MB)`;
                  process.stderr.write(process.stderr.isTTY ? `\r${line}` : `${line}\n`);
                  if (p.percentage >= 100)
                      process.stderr.write('\n');

              const outputPath = path.join(outputDir, `flux2_img2img_${i}.png`);
              fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, buffers[i]);
              console.log(`â–¸ Saved ${outputPath}`);
          }
          console.log('â–¸ Stats:', await stats);
          await unloadModel({ modelId, clearStorage: false });
          console.log('â–¸ Done');
      ```

    <WrapCode>
      ```python file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk-python/examples/diffusion_flux2_klein_img2img.py title="diffusion_flux2_klein_img2img.py" lineNumbers
      """Python port of packages/sdk/examples/diffusion-flux2-klein-img2img.ts.

      img2img with FLUX.2 [klein] split-layout -- uses in-context conditioning
      ("flux2_flow").

      TypeScript's `diffusion()` takes `init_image` as raw bytes and base64-encodes
      them on the way to the worker. Python calls the worker directly through
      `diffusion_stream`, where `init_image` is already the encoded string, so the
      example encodes the file itself. The same iterator then carries progress, the
      finished images and the closing stats, which TypeScript receives as three
      separate channels.

      No `width`/`height` is passed, so the generation runs at the input image's
      size. A large input therefore means much more work per step.

      RUN: python examples/diffusion_flux2_klein_img2img.py <input-image> [prompt] [output-dir] [diffusion-src] [llm-src] [vae-src]
      """

      from __future__ import annotations

      import asyncio
      import base64
      import sys
      from pathlib import Path

      from tetherto.qvac_sdk import (
          Client,
          DiffusionStreamRequest,
          diffusion_stream,
          load_model,
          unload_model,
      )
      from tetherto.qvac_sdk.models import (
          FLUX_2_KLEIN_4B_Q4_0,
          FLUX_2_KLEIN_4B_VAE,
          QWEN3_4B_Q4_K_M,
      )


      def print_progress(p) -> None:
          """Print model download progress; pass as `on_progress=` to `load_model`."""
          line = (
              f"â–¸ Downloading {p.percentage:.0f}% "
              f"({p.downloaded / 1e6:.1f}/{p.total / 1e6:.1f} MB)"
          )
          print(line, end="\r" if sys.stderr.isatty() else "\n", file=sys.stderr)
          if p.percentage >= 100:
              print(file=sys.stderr)


      async def main() -> int:
          input_path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else None
          prompt = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "oil painting style, vibrant colors"
          output_dir = Path(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else Path(".")
          diffusion_model_src = sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) > 4 else FLUX_2_KLEIN_4B_Q4_0
          llm_model_src = sys.argv[5] if len(sys.argv) > 5 else QWEN3_4B_Q4_K_M
          vae_model_src = sys.argv[6] if len(sys.argv) > 6 else FLUX_2_KLEIN_4B_VAE

          if not input_path:
              print("âœ– input image path is required", file=sys.stderr)
              print(
                  "Usage: python examples/diffusion_flux2_klein_img2img.py <inputImage> "
                  "[prompt] [outputDir] [diffusionModelSrc] [llmModelSrc] [vaeModelSrc]",
                  file=sys.stderr,
              )
              return 1

          try:
              async with Client() as client:
                  t = client.transport

                  print("â–¸ Loading FLUX.2 [klein] split-layout model...")
                  model_id = await load_model(
                      t,
                      model_src=diffusion_model_src,
                      model_type="sdcpp-generation",
                      model_config={
                          "device": "gpu",
                          "threads": 4,
                          "llmModelSrc": llm_model_src,
                          "vaeModelSrc": vae_model_src,
                          "prediction": "flux2_flow",
                      },
                      on_progress=print_progress,
                  )
                  print(f"â–¸ Model loaded: {model_id}")

                  init_image = base64.b64encode(Path(input_path).read_bytes()).decode("ascii")
                  print(f'â–¸ Transforming "{input_path}" with prompt: "{prompt}"')

                  request = DiffusionStreamRequest.model_validate(
                      {
                          "type": "diffusionStream",
                          "modelId": model_id,
                          "prompt": prompt,
                          "init_image": init_image,
                          "steps": 20,
                          "guidance": 3.5,
                          "cfg_scale": 1,
                          "seed": -1,
                      }
                  )

                  images: list[bytes] = []
                  stats = None
                  async for response in diffusion_stream(t, request):
                      if response.step is not None and response.total_steps is not None:
                          print(f"â–¸ step {response.step:.0f}/{response.total_steps:.0f}")
                      if response.data is not None:
                          images.append(base64.b64decode(response.data))
                      if response.done:
                          stats = response.stats

                  for index, image in enumerate(images):
                      output_path = output_dir / f"flux2_img2img_{index}.png"
                      output_path.write_bytes(image)
                      print(f"â–¸ Saved {output_path}")

                  print("â–¸ Stats:", stats.model_dump(exclude_none=True) if stats else None)

                  await unload_model(t, model_id)
                  print("â–¸ Done")
          except Exception as error:
              print("âœ–", error, file=sys.stderr)
              return 1

          return 0


      if __name__ == "__main__":
          sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))
      ```
    </WrapCode>

### Upscaling

#### Post-processing

Pass `upscale` to `diffusion()` to upscale generated images in the same call. Requires `modelConfig.upscaler = { type: "esrgan", model_src, tile_size? }` at `loadModel()` time. Behavior depends on the value passed:

* `true` (or `{}` / `{ repeats: 1 }`): single pass at the model's native scale factor (e.g. `x4` for RealESRGAN\_x4plus).
* `{ repeats: N }`: N sequential passes â€” each pass multiplies the output dimensions by the model's scale factor (e.g. `repeats: 2` with an `x4` model â†’ `x16`).
* When `batch_count > 1`, every output image is upscaled independently.

<Callout type="info">
  Qwen-Image-2.1 produces RGBA and rejects this option; leave `upscale` omitted or `false`.
</Callout>

The following script loads SD 2.1 with an ESRGAN upscaler and generates both a single-pass (`x4`) and a two-pass (`x16`) upscale from the same prompt:

<Tabs>
  <Tab value="js" label="JavaScript" default>
    <WrapCode>
      ```js file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk/dist/examples/diffusion-esrgan-upscale.js title="diffusion-esrgan-upscale.js" lineNumbers
      import { loadModel, unloadModel, diffusion, SD_V2_1_1B_Q8_0, REALESRGAN_X4PLUS_ANIME_6B } from '@qvac/sdk';
      import fs from 'fs';
      import path from 'path';
      // ESRGAN upscale example.
      //
      // Usage:
      //   npx tsx examples/diffusion-esrgan-upscale.ts [esrganSrc] [prompt] [outputDir]
      const esrganArg = process.argv[2];
      const promptArg = process.argv[3];
      const outputDirArg = process.argv[4];
      const esrganModelSrc = esrganArg ?? REALESRGAN_X4PLUS_ANIME_6B;
      const prompt = promptArg ??
          'an illustrated red fox portrait, clean line art, soft watercolor background, detailed fur, crisp eyes';
      const negative_prompt = 'blurry, low quality, watermark, text';
      const outputDir = outputDirArg ?? '.';
      const seed = 42;
      try {
          console.log('â–¸ Loading SD 2.1 + ESRGAN upscaler...');
          const modelId = await loadModel({
              modelSrc: SD_V2_1_1B_Q8_0,
              modelConfig: {
                  prediction: 'v',
                  upscaler: {
                      type: 'esrgan',
                      model_src: esrganModelSrc,
                      tile_size: 128
                  }
              },
              onProgress: (p) => {
                  const mb = (n) => (n / 1e6).toFixed(1);
                  const line = `â–¸ Downloading ${p.percentage.toFixed(0)}% (${mb(p.downloaded)}/${mb(p.total)} MB)`;
                  process.stderr.write(process.stderr.isTTY ? `\r${line}` : `${line}\n`);
                  if (p.percentage >= 100)
                      process.stderr.write('\n');
              }
          });
          console.log(`â–¸ Model loaded: ${modelId}`);
          // Source size is intentionally small â€” each ESRGAN repeat multiplies dimensions.
          const baseParams = {
              modelId,
              prompt,
              negative_prompt,
              width: 128,
              height: 128,
              steps: 5,
              cfg_scale: 7.5,
              seed
          };
          console.log(`â–¸ Generating ESRGAN x4 upscale: "${prompt}"`);
          const single = diffusion({ ...baseParams, upscale: true });
          for await (const { step, totalSteps } of single.progressStream) {
              console.log(`â–¸ step ${step}/${totalSteps}`);
          }
          const singleBuffers = await single.outputs;
          for (let i = 0; i < singleBuffers.length; i++) {
              const out = path.join(outputDir, `sd2_esrgan_x4_seed${seed}_${i}.png`);
              fs.writeFileSync(out, singleBuffers[i]);
              console.log(`â–¸ Saved ${out}`);
          }
          console.log('â–¸ Stats:', await single.stats);
          console.log('â–¸ Generating ESRGAN two-pass x16 upscale...');
          const twoPass = diffusion({ ...baseParams, upscale: { repeats: 2 } });
          for await (const { step, totalSteps } of twoPass.progressStream) {
              console.log(`â–¸ step ${step}/${totalSteps}`);
          }
          const twoPassBuffers = await twoPass.outputs;
          for (let i = 0; i < twoPassBuffers.length; i++) {
              const out = path.join(outputDir, `sd2_esrgan_x16_seed${seed}_${i}.png`);
              fs.writeFileSync(out, twoPassBuffers[i]);
              console.log(`â–¸ Saved ${out}`);
          }
          console.log('â–¸ Stats:', await twoPass.stats);
          await unloadModel({ modelId, clearStorage: false });
          console.log('â–¸ Done');
          process.exit(0);
      }
      catch (error) {
          console.error('âœ–', error);
          process.exit(1);
      }
      ```

    <WrapCode>
      ```python file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk-python/examples/diffusion_esrgan_upscale.py title="diffusion_esrgan_upscale.py" lineNumbers
      """Python port of packages/sdk/examples/diffusion-esrgan-upscale.ts.

      ESRGAN post-processing: the upscaler is attached to the diffusion model at
      `load_model` time via `model_config["upscaler"]`, then triggered per
      generation with the request's `upscale` field. Two generations run from the
      same seed and prompt -- one single pass (x4) and one two-pass (x16) -- so the
      only difference between them is `upscale`.

      The ESRGAN constant goes inside `model_config`, not as the top-level
      `model_src`, and needs no conversion: `load_model` reduces every model
      descriptor it finds anywhere in the config to its `src` string.

      Like the other diffusion examples, this one demultiplexes the single
      `diffusion_stream` iterator into the per-step progress, the finished images
      and the closing stats that TypeScript receives as three separate channels.

      RUN: python examples/diffusion_esrgan_upscale.py [esrgan-src] [prompt] [output-dir]
      """

      from __future__ import annotations

      import asyncio
      import base64
      import sys
      from pathlib import Path

      from tetherto.qvac_sdk import (
          Client,
          DiffusionStreamRequest,
          diffusion_stream,
          load_model,
          unload_model,
      )
      from tetherto.qvac_sdk.models import REALESRGAN_X4PLUS_ANIME_6B, SD_V2_1_1B_Q8_0


      def print_progress(p) -> None:
          """Print model download progress; pass as `on_progress=` to `load_model`."""
          line = (
              f"â–¸ Downloading {p.percentage:.0f}% "
              f"({p.downloaded / 1e6:.1f}/{p.total / 1e6:.1f} MB)"
          )
          print(line, end="\r" if sys.stderr.isatty() else "\n", file=sys.stderr)
          if p.percentage >= 100:
              print(file=sys.stderr)


      async def main() -> int:
          esrgan_model_src = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else REALESRGAN_X4PLUS_ANIME_6B
          prompt = (
              sys.argv[2]
              if len(sys.argv) > 2
              else "an illustrated red fox portrait, clean line art, "
              "soft watercolor background, detailed fur, crisp eyes"
          )
          negative_prompt = "blurry, low quality, watermark, text"
          output_dir = Path(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else Path(".")
          seed = 42

          print("â–¸ Loading SD 2.1 + ESRGAN upscaler...")

          async with Client() as client:
              t = client.transport

              model_id = await load_model(
                  t,
                  model_src=SD_V2_1_1B_Q8_0,
                  model_type="sdcpp-generation",
                  model_config={
                      "prediction": "v",
                      "upscaler": {
                          "type": "esrgan",
                          "model_src": esrgan_model_src,
                          "tile_size": 128,
                      },
                  },
                  on_progress=print_progress,
              )
              print(f"â–¸ Model loaded: {model_id}")

              # Source size is intentionally small -- each ESRGAN repeat multiplies
              # dimensions.
              base_params = {
                  "type": "diffusionStream",
                  "modelId": model_id,
                  "prompt": prompt,
                  "negative_prompt": negative_prompt,
                  "width": 128,
                  "height": 128,
                  "steps": 5,
                  "cfg_scale": 7.5,
                  "seed": seed,
              }

              print(f'â–¸ Generating ESRGAN x4 upscale: "{prompt}"')
              single = DiffusionStreamRequest.model_validate({**base_params, "upscale": True})

              single_images: list[bytes] = []
              single_stats = None
              async for response in diffusion_stream(t, single):
                  if response.step is not None and response.total_steps is not None:
                      print(f"â–¸ step {response.step:.0f}/{response.total_steps:.0f}")
                  if response.data is not None:
                      single_images.append(base64.b64decode(response.data))
                  if response.done:
                      single_stats = response.stats

              for index, image in enumerate(single_images):
                  output_path = output_dir / f"sd2_esrgan_x4_seed{seed}_{index}.png"
                  output_path.write_bytes(image)
                  print(f"â–¸ Saved {output_path}")

              print(
                  "â–¸ Stats:",
                  single_stats.model_dump(exclude_none=True) if single_stats else None,
              )

              print("â–¸ Generating ESRGAN two-pass x16 upscale...")
              two_pass = DiffusionStreamRequest.model_validate(
                  {**base_params, "upscale": {"repeats": 2}}
              )

              two_pass_images: list[bytes] = []
              two_pass_stats = None
              async for response in diffusion_stream(t, two_pass):
                  if response.step is not None and response.total_steps is not None:
                      print(f"â–¸ step {response.step:.0f}/{response.total_steps:.0f}")
                  if response.data is not None:
                      two_pass_images.append(base64.b64decode(response.data))
                  if response.done:
                      two_pass_stats = response.stats

              for index, image in enumerate(two_pass_images):
                  output_path = output_dir / f"sd2_esrgan_x16_seed{seed}_{index}.png"
                  output_path.write_bytes(image)
                  print(f"â–¸ Saved {output_path}")

              print(
                  "â–¸ Stats:",
                  two_pass_stats.model_dump(exclude_none=True) if two_pass_stats else None,
              )

              await unload_model(t, model_id, clear_storage=False)

          print("â–¸ Done")
          return 0


      if __name__ == "__main__":
          sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))
      ```
    </WrapCode>
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

#### Standalone

The SDK also exposes `upscale()` â€” a standalone path that upscales any PNG/JPEG image without running diffusion. Load the ESRGAN model directly with `modelConfig.mode: "upscale"`:

```ts
const modelId = await loadModel(REALESRGAN_X4PLUS_ANIME_6B, {
  modelType: "diffusion",
  modelConfig: { mode: "upscale", upscaler: { tile_size: 128 } },
});
const { outputs } = upscale({ modelId, image: pngBytes, repeats: 2 });
const [upscaledPng] = await outputs;
```

`tile_size` defaults to 128. Increase it to reduce tile seams on large inputs, at the cost of more memory per pass.

<Callout type="success">
  **Tip:** all examples throughout this documentation are self-contained and runnable. For instructions on how to run them, see the [JS/TS quickstart](/sdk/js-ts-sdk#quickstart) or the [Python quickstart](/sdk/python-sdk#quickstart).
</Callout>

# Multimodal (/sdk/ai-capabilities/multimodal)



## Overview

[Text generation](/sdk/ai-capabilities/text-generation) supports multimodal prompts. Multimodal lets you attach media files to inputs for [`completion()`](/sdk/reference/api#completion). You can include multiple attachments in the same request (e.g., to compare two images).

Compared to text-only completion inference, the key differences are:

* You must load a multimodal-capable LLM **and** its matching `projectionModelSrc` via [`loadModel()`](/sdk/reference/api#loadmodel).
* Your `history` messages can include `attachments: [{ path: "/path/to/image.jpg" }]` (the file must exist on disk).
* Images larger than 50 megapixels (width Ã— height) are rejected before decoding. To accept larger images, raise the limit at load time with `modelConfig['image-max-megapixels']` (a positive integer, in millions of pixels).
* Aside from attachments, you still call `completion({ modelId, history, stream })` the same way and consume the same streaming output.

## Functions

Use the following sequence of function calls:

1. [`loadModel()`](/sdk/reference/api#loadmodel)
2. [`completion()`](/sdk/reference/api#completion)
3. [`unloadModel()`](/sdk/reference/api#unloadmodel)

For how to use each function, see [SDK â€” API reference](/sdk/reference/api/).

## Models

You should load two models:

* a `llama.cpp`-compatible multimodal-capable LLM. Model file format: `*.gguf`; and
* a matching projection model (`mmproj-*.gguf`). Model file format: `*.gguf`.

Recommended pairs:

* VisionPsy Nano â€” one weights + `mmproj` pair per variant (choose the pair for the variant you want):
  * Flash: `VISIONPSY_NANO_460M_MULTIMODAL_Q8_0` (or `..._Q4_K_M`) + `MMPROJ_VISIONPSY_NANO_460M_MULTIMODAL_Q8_0`.
  * Base: `VISIONPSY_NANO_460M_MULTIMODAL_Q8_0_1` (or `..._Q4_K_M_1`) + `MMPROJ_VISIONPSY_NANO_460M_MULTIMODAL_Q8_0_1`.
  * Note: the un-suffixed constants are Flash; the `_1`-suffixed constants are base.
* Qwen2.5-Omni + mmproj-\* (or Qwen3-VL + mmproj-\*)
* SmolVLM2 + mmproj-\*

For models available as constants, see [SDK â€” Models](/sdk#models).

### VisionPsy Nano: base vs. Flash

VisionPsy Nano ships in two variants â€” base and Flash â€” as separate weights + `mmproj` pairs (see the constants above). Pick a variant by loading its matching pair; the flag `modelConfig.image_no_upscale` supplies the preprocessing rule the two mmprojs cannot express through their (identical) metadata, so you must set it to match the pair you loaded:

* Base pair: leave `image_no_upscale` unset (the field is optional; unset defers to the mmproj's own value).
* Flash pair: set `image_no_upscale: 'on'`.

Loading Flash weights with `image_no_upscale` unset â€” or base weights with `image_no_upscale: 'on'` â€” passes load validation (both mmprojs declare the same `preproc_image_size`), but silently uses the wrong preprocessing rule and degrades quality.

`image_no_upscale` is read only by the idefics3-style preprocessor, and it takes effect only when the loaded `mmproj` declares `clip.vision.preproc_image_size`. In practice, that means the VisionPsy pairs above â€” on the other recommended pairs the flag either warns and is ignored (Qwen2.5-Omni / Qwen3-VL) or is accepted but inert (SmolVLM2, whose published `mmproj` declares no `preproc_image_size`). Treat `image_no_upscale` as a VisionPsy-only key.

## Example

The following script shows an example of multimodal completion with one image (and optionally two):

<Tabs>
  <Tab value="js" label="JavaScript" default>

      ```js file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk/dist/examples/llamacpp-multimodal.js title="multimodal.js" lineNumbers
      import { completion, loadModel, SMOLVLM2_500M_MULTIMODAL_Q8_0, MMPROJ_SMOLVLM2_500M_MULTIMODAL_Q8_0, unloadModel } from '@qvac/sdk';
      if (process.argv.length < 3) {
          console.error(`â–¸ Specify an image file path as the first argument and a second image file path as the second (optional) argument`);
          process.exit(1);
      }
      try {
          // const modelPath = args[modelIndex + 1]!;
          const imageFilePath = process.argv[2];
          // Load the main model with projection in a single step
          const modelId = await loadModel({
              modelSrc: SMOLVLM2_500M_MULTIMODAL_Q8_0,
              modelConfig: {
                  // An image is tiled into hundreds of context units before a single word
                  // of the prompt is counted, and the comparison below sends two at once.
                  ctx_size: 8192,
                  projectionModelSrc: MMPROJ_SMOLVLM2_500M_MULTIMODAL_Q8_0
              },
              onProgress: (p) => {
                  const mb = (n) => (n / 1e6).toFixed(1);
                  const line = `â–¸ Downloading ${p.percentage.toFixed(0)}% (${mb(p.downloaded)}/${mb(p.total)} MB)`;
                  process.stderr.write(process.stderr.isTTY ? `\r${line}` : `${line}\n`);
                  if (p.percentage >= 100)
                      process.stderr.write('\n');
              }
          });
          //Using one particular media
          const history = [
              {
                  role: 'user',
                  content: "What's in this image?",
                  attachments: [{ path: imageFilePath }]
              }
          ];
          const result = completion({ modelId, history, stream: true });
          for await (const token of result.tokenStream) {
              process.stdout.write(token);
          }
          const stats = await result.stats;
          console.log('\nâ–¸ Performance Stats:', stats);
          console.log('â–¸ --------------------------------');
          //Using multiple media
          if (process.argv.length < 4) {
              console.log(`â–¸ Only one image provided, terminating`);
              process.exit(0);
          }
          const imageFilePath2 = process.argv[3];
          const history2 = [
              {
                  role: 'user',
                  content: 'Compare the two newspaper articles',
                  attachments: [{ path: imageFilePath }, { path: imageFilePath2 }]
              }
          ];
          const result2 = completion({ modelId, history: history2, stream: true });
          for await (const token of result2.tokenStream) {
              process.stdout.write(token);
          }
          const stats2 = await result2.stats;
          console.log('\nâ–¸ Performance Stats:', stats2);
          console.log('â–¸ --------------------------------');
          await unloadModel({ modelId, clearStorage: false });
      }
      catch (error) {
          console.error('âœ–', error);
          process.exit(1);
      }
      ```

      ```python file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk-python/examples/multimodal.py title="multimodal.py" lineNumbers
      """Multimodal completion â€” Python port of
      packages/sdk/examples/llamacpp-multimodal.ts.

      Load a multimodal LLM together with its matching projection model, then hang
      `attachments` off a user turn: one image first, then both images in a single
      request so the model can compare them.

      RUN: python examples/multimodal.py <image path> [<second image path>]
      """

      from __future__ import annotations

      import asyncio
      import sys

      from tetherto.qvac_sdk import Client, completion, load_model, unload_model
      from tetherto.qvac_sdk.models import (
          MMPROJ_SMOLVLM2_500M_MULTIMODAL_Q8_0,
          SMOLVLM2_500M_MULTIMODAL_Q8_0,
      )


      def print_progress(p) -> None:
          """Print model download progress; pass as `on_progress=` to `load_model`."""
          line = (
              f"â–¸ Downloading {p.percentage:.0f}% "
              f"({p.downloaded / 1e6:.1f}/{p.total / 1e6:.1f} MB)"
          )
          print(line, end="\r" if sys.stderr.isatty() else "\n", file=sys.stderr)
          if p.percentage >= 100:
              print(file=sys.stderr)


      async def main() -> int:
          if len(sys.argv) < 2:
              print(
                  "â–¸ Specify an image file path as the first argument and a second "
                  "image file path as the second (optional) argument",
                  file=sys.stderr,
              )
              return 1

          image_file_path = sys.argv[1]

          async with Client() as client:
              t = client.transport
              try:
                  # Load the main model with projection in a single step
                  model_id = await load_model(
                      t,
                      model_src=SMOLVLM2_500M_MULTIMODAL_Q8_0,
                      model_config={
                          # An image is tiled into hundreds of context units before a
                          # single word of the prompt is counted, and the comparison
                          # below sends two at once.
                          "ctx_size": 8192,
                          "projectionModelSrc": MMPROJ_SMOLVLM2_500M_MULTIMODAL_Q8_0,
                      },
                      on_progress=print_progress,
                  )

                  # Using one particular media
                  history = [
                      {
                          "role": "user",
                          "content": "What's in this image?",
                          "attachments": [{"path": image_file_path}],
                      }
                  ]
                  run = completion(t, model_id=model_id, history=history, stream=True)

                  async for event in run.events:
                      if event.type == "contentDelta":
                          sys.stdout.write(event.text)
                          sys.stdout.flush()

                  final = await run.final
                  print("\nâ–¸ Performance Stats:", final.stats)
                  print("â–¸ --------------------------------")

                  # Using multiple media
                  if len(sys.argv) < 3:
                      print("â–¸ Only one image provided, terminating")
                      return 0

                  image_file_path2 = sys.argv[2]

                  history2 = [
                      {
                          "role": "user",
                          "content": "Compare the two newspaper articles",
                          "attachments": [
                              {"path": image_file_path},
                              {"path": image_file_path2},
                          ],
                      }
                  ]
                  run2 = completion(t, model_id=model_id, history=history2, stream=True)

                  async for event in run2.events:
                      if event.type == "contentDelta":
                          sys.stdout.write(event.text)
                          sys.stdout.flush()

                  final2 = await run2.final
                  print("\nâ–¸ Performance Stats:", final2.stats)
                  print("â–¸ --------------------------------")

                  await unload_model(t, model_id)
              except Exception as error:
                  print(f"âœ– {error}", file=sys.stderr)
                  return 1
          return 0


      if __name__ == "__main__":
          sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))
      ```
