### Utils

The JS and TS examples above import these helpers to save the PCM samples as a WAV file and play it. Save the file in the same folder as the example. The Python examples include the same helpers inline. Playback requires `ffplay`, which ships with ffmpeg.

<Tabs>
  <Tab value="js" label="JavaScript" default>
    <WrapCode>
      ```js file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk/dist/examples/tts/utils.js title="utils.js" lineNumbers
      import { writeFileSync, unlinkSync } from 'fs';
      import { spawn, spawnSync } from 'child_process';
      import { platform, tmpdir } from 'os';
      import { join } from 'path';
      /**
       * Create WAV header for 16-bit PCM audio
       */
      export function createWavHeader(dataLength, sampleRate) {
          const header = Buffer.alloc(44);
          // RIFF header
          header.write('RIFF', 0);
          header.writeUInt32LE(36 + dataLength, 4);
          header.write('WAVE', 8);
          // fmt chunk
          header.write('fmt ', 12);
          header.writeUInt32LE(16, 16); // fmt chunk size
          header.writeUInt16LE(1, 20); // PCM format
          header.writeUInt16LE(1, 22); // mono
          header.writeUInt32LE(sampleRate, 24);
          header.writeUInt32LE(sampleRate * 2, 28); // byte rate
          header.writeUInt16LE(2, 32); // block align
          header.writeUInt16LE(16, 34); // bits per sample
          // data chunk
          header.write('data', 36);
          header.writeUInt32LE(dataLength, 40);
          return header;
      }
      /**
       * Convert Int16Array to Buffer
       */
      export function int16ArrayToBuffer(samples) {
          const buffer = Buffer.alloc(samples.length * 2);
          for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) {
              const value = Math.max(-32768, Math.min(32767, Math.round(samples[i] ?? 0)));
              buffer.writeInt16LE(value, i * 2);
          }
          return buffer;
      }
      /**
       * Create and save WAV file
       */
      export function createWav(audioBuffer, sampleRate, filename) {
          const audioData = int16ArrayToBuffer(audioBuffer);
          const wavHeader = createWavHeader(audioData.length, sampleRate);
          const wavFile = Buffer.concat([wavHeader, audioData]);
          writeFileSync(filename, wavFile);
          console.log(`â–¸ WAV file saved as: ${filename}`);
      }
      /**
       * Play a WAV buffer by streaming it into ffplay over stdin.
       *
       * ffplay ships with ffmpeg and is cross-platform (macOS/Linux/Windows), so
       * we avoid the old "write to /tmp then shell out to afplay/aplay/powershell"
       * dance â€” no temp files, no platform switch, no hardcoded /tmp path (which
       * doesn't exist on Windows). Requires ffplay on PATH.
       */
      /**
       * Play one mono s16le PCM chunk (as a minimal WAV) and wait for the player to finish.
       * Chunks are played sequentially when awaited in order â€” suitable for streaming TTS output.
       */
      export function playPcmInt16Chunk(samples, sampleRate) {
          if (samples.length === 0) {
              return Promise.resolve();
          }
          const audioData = int16ArrayToBuffer(samples);
          const wavHeader = createWavHeader(audioData.length, sampleRate);
          const wavFile = Buffer.concat([wavHeader, audioData]);
          // `os.tmpdir()` resolves to the OS-specific temp directory (e.g. `%TEMP%`
          // on Windows), so the Windows branch below no longer tries to read a
          // POSIX-only `/tmp/...` path.
          const tempFile = join(tmpdir(), `qvac-tts-chunk-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}.wav`);
          writeFileSync(tempFile, wavFile);
          const currentPlatform = platform();
          let audioPlayer;
          let args;
          switch (currentPlatform) {
              case 'darwin':
                  audioPlayer = 'afplay';
                  args = [tempFile];
                  break;
              case 'linux':
                  audioPlayer = 'aplay';
                  args = [tempFile];
                  break;
              case 'win32':
                  audioPlayer = 'powershell';
                  args = [
                      '-Command',
                      `Add-Type -AssemblyName presentationCore; (New-Object Media.SoundPlayer).LoadStream([System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes('${tempFile}')).PlaySync()`
                  ];
                  break;
              default:
                  audioPlayer = 'aplay';
                  args = [tempFile];
          }
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
              const proc = spawn(audioPlayer, args, { stdio: 'ignore' });
              proc.on('error', function (err) {
                  try {
                      unlinkSync(tempFile);
                  }
                  catch {
                      // ignore
                  }
                  reject(err);
              });
              proc.on('close', function (code) {
                  try {
                      unlinkSync(tempFile);
                  }
                  catch {
                      // ignore
                  }
                  if (code === 0) {
                      resolve();
                  }
                  else {
                      reject(new Error(`Audio player exited with code ${code}`));
                  }
              });
          });
      }
      export function playAudio(audioBuffer) {
          const result = spawnSync('ffplay', ['-hide_banner', '-loglevel', 'error', '-autoexit', '-nodisp', '-i', 'pipe:0'], {
              input: audioBuffer,
              stdio: ['pipe', 'inherit', 'inherit']
          });
          if (result.error) {
              const code = result.error.code;
              if (code === 'ENOENT') {
                  throw new Error('ffplay not found on PATH. Install ffmpeg (ffplay ships with it) and retry.');
              }
              throw new Error(`ffplay failed: ${result.error.message}`);
          }
          if (result.status !== 0) {
              throw new Error(`ffplay exited with code ${result.status}`);
          }
      }
      ```

      ```ts file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk/examples/tts/utils.ts title="utils.ts" lineNumbers
            args = [tempFile]

            ]

            args = [tempFile]
        }

          proc.on('error', function (err) {
            try {

            }
          })

      export function playAudio(audioBuffer: Buffer): void {
        const result = spawnSync(
          'ffplay',
          ['-hide_banner', '-loglevel', 'error', '-autoexit', '-nodisp', '-i', 'pipe:0'],
          {

            stdio: ['pipe', 'inherit', 'inherit']
      ```

# Transcription (/sdk/ai-capabilities/transcription)



## Overview

Transcription uses your choice of either [`qvac-fabric-speech.cpp`](https://github.com/tetherto/qvac-fabric-speech.cpp) or [NVIDIA Parakeet](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3) (via the GGML-based [`parakeet-cpp`](https://github.com/tetherto/qvac-fabric-speech.cpp/tree/master/engines/parakeet) engine) as inference engine. Load a model using `modelType: "whisper"` for `qvac-fabric-speech.cpp`, or `modelType: "parakeet-transcription"` for Parakeet. Parakeet supports multilingual transcription (TDT), English-only transcription (CTC), English transcription with a single model that supports both batch and duplex streaming (Unified), the small [TranscribePsy](https://huggingface.co/qvac/TranscribePsy-250M-EU-sub-gguf) distillation for eight European languages, Indic-language transcription (Indic Conformer CTC), speaker diarization (Sortformer and Nemotron 3), and end-of-utterance detection (EOU) for duplex streaming.

Provide audio input as `audioChunk`, either as a file path (string) or an in-memory audio buffer.

`transcribe()` returns the full transcription as a single `string`. Its returned promise also exposes `stats`: await it after transcription to read terminal engine statistics. For Parakeet offline ASR, `encoderOnCoreml` reports whether a Core ML sidecar loaded, while `encoderUsedCoreml` reports whether this run encoded on Core ML. The stats promise resolves to `undefined` when the engine does not report statistics. If you need partial results as they become available, use `transcribeStream()` to receive text chunks in real-time. Both whisper and parakeet expose duplex `transcribeStream()` sessions; see "Streaming with `transcribeStream()`" below.

## Functions

Use the following sequence of function calls:

1. [`loadModel()`](/sdk/reference/api#loadmodel)
2. [`transcribe()`](/sdk/reference/api#transcribe) or [`transcribeStream()`](/sdk/reference/api#transcribestream)
3. [`unloadModel()`](/sdk/reference/api#unloadmodel)

For how to use each function, see [SDK â€” API reference](/sdk/reference/api/).

## Models

### `qvac-fabric-speech.cpp`

You should load two models:

* a [`whisper.cpp`](https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp)-compatible model for transcription. Model file format: `*.bin`; and
* a VAD model (e.g., Silero) converted to GGML. Model file format: `*.bin` *(optional, recommended)*.

### Parakeet

Parakeet uses a GGUF checkpoint per variant, and the addon detects TDT / CTC / Unified / Sortformer / EOU from its GGUF metadata (TranscribePsy loads as a TDT model). Supply the GGUF via the top-level `modelSrc`:

```ts
await loadModel({
  modelSrc: PARAKEET_TDT_0_6B_V3_Q8_0,    // multilingual, ~750MB
  modelType: "parakeet-transcription",
});

await loadModel({
  modelSrc: PARAKEET_CTC_0_6B_Q8_0,       // english-only, streaming-capable
  modelType: "parakeet-transcription",
});

await loadModel({
  modelSrc: PARAKEET_UNIFIED_0_6B_Q8_0,   // english; batch + streaming, ~740MB
  modelType: "parakeet-transcription",
});

await loadModel({
  modelSrc: PARAKEET_TRANSCRIBEPSY_250M_Q8_0,  // nl/en/fr/de/it/pl/pt/es, ~305MB
  modelType: "parakeet-transcription",
});

await loadModel({
  modelSrc: PARAKEET_SORTFORMER_4SPK_V2_1_Q8_0,  // 4-speaker diarization
  modelType: "parakeet-transcription",
});

await loadModel({
  modelSrc: PARAKEET_EOU_120M_V1_Q8_0,    // end-of-utterance detection
  modelType: "parakeet-transcription",
});

await loadModel({
  modelSrc: PARAKEET_INDIC_CONFORMER_600M_Q8_0,  // Indic languages
  modelType: "parakeet-transcription",
  modelConfig: { language: "hi" },              // required; e.g. "hi", "ta"
});
```

On macOS and iOS, loading a supported Parakeet registry constant also downloads its complete Core ML encoder bundle and stages the `.mlmodelc` directory beside the GGUF. This applies to TDT 0.6B v3, Unified English 0.6B, EOU 120M v1, and streaming Sortformer v2.1. The sidecar weights increase the first download and disk use. Other platforms download the GGUF alone; if a sidecar is unavailable or cannot load, the GGUF encoder is used.

TranscribePsy publishes a separate Core ML distribution. `PARAKEET_TRANSCRIBEPSY_250M_COREML_Q8_0` is an encoder-less GGUF whose encoder and decoder bundles the SDK downloads and stages beside it, so both stages run on the Apple Neural Engine; `stats.encoderUsedCoreml` on the `transcribe()` call reports it. That constant loads on macOS and iOS only: elsewhere the load is refused up front, and `PARAKEET_TRANSCRIBEPSY_250M_Q8_0` is the one to use.

**Long recordings.** Parakeet encodes a long `transcribe()` input in overlapping windows, so memory stays flat however long the recording is and cancellation lands between windows. The defaults need nothing from you: TranscribePsy uses the 60 s windows with 25 % overlap it recommends, the other models the engine's automatic windows. To trade speed for a smaller footprint, for example on a phone with little memory, set `longFormWindowFrames` and `longFormContextFrames` in `modelConfig` (encoder frames of 80 ms: 375 is a 30 s window, and 47 frames of context on each side keeps the 25 % overlap); a negative window encodes the whole input in one pass.

For model artifacts available as constants, see [SDK â€” Models](/sdk#models).

<Callout type="info">
  **Migrating from pre-0.6 Parakeet (ONNX multi-file):** the legacy multi-file ONNX `modelConfig` shape (`parakeetEncoderSrc` / `parakeetDecoderSrc` / `parakeetVocabSrc` / `parakeetPreprocessorSrc`, plus `parakeetCtcModelSrc` / `parakeetTokenizerSrc` and `parakeetSortformerSrc` for the CTC/Sortformer variants) is no longer supported. Passing any of those fields raises a structured `LegacyParakeetModelDeprecatedError` with a migration message. The legacy ONNX constants (e.g. `PARAKEET_TDT_ENCODER_INT8`, `PARAKEET_CTC_FP32`, `PARAKEET_SORTFORMER_FP32`) remain exported for one minor cycle for codemod migrations only and will be removed in a future release.
</Callout>

<Callout type="info">
  **On VAD:** when using `qvac-fabric-speech.cpp`, you can optionally provide a separate model for voice activity detection (VAD); this is recommended. In turn, Parakeet handles VAD internally, so no additional model or configuration is required.
</Callout>

## Speaker-aware MOSS transcription

MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize performs batch transcription with timestamps and speaker labels.
Load `MOSS_TRANSCRIBE_DIARIZE_Q8_0` (or the F16/Q5\_0 variant) with the
`moss-transcribe` model type. Registry constants select the type automatically.

```ts
import { loadModel, transcribe, MOSS_TRANSCRIBE_DIARIZE_Q8_0 } from '@qvac/sdk'

const modelId = await loadModel({ modelSrc: MOSS_TRANSCRIBE_DIARIZE_Q8_0 })
const segments = await transcribe({
  modelId,
  audioChunk: 'meeting.wav',
  metadata: true,
  hotwords: ['QVAC'],
  maxNewTokens: 2048
})
```

Segments include `speaker` labels such as `S01`, zero-based `speakerId`, and
`startMs`/`endMs`. Hotwords are request-specific: up to 64 nonempty terms, each
at most 64 UTF-8 bytes. A custom `prompt` cannot be combined with hotwords.
`maxNewTokens: 0` uses the model default. MOSS supports whole-recording batch
inference; duplex streaming and configuration reload are unavailable.

Before downloading weights, call `assessModelFit` with the longest recording
you plan to transcribe and matching decoding options:

```ts
import { assessModelFit, MOSS_TRANSCRIBE_DIARIZE_Q8_0 } from "@qvac/sdk";

const fit = await assessModelFit({
  models: [
    {
      modelSrc: MOSS_TRANSCRIBE_DIARIZE_Q8_0,
      modelConfig: { useGPU: false },
      transcriptionWorkload: {
        audioSeconds: 300,
        hotwords: ["QVAC"],
        maxNewTokens: 0,
      },
    },
  ],
});
```

`transcriptionWorkload` is fit-only and requires a positive duration in seconds.
It accepts the same prompt, hotwords, and token limit as MOSS transcription;
omit either prompt or hotwords. Without a declared workload or an available
registry description/local model, the assessment can remain `unknown`.
Assessment does not load the model, reserve memory, or block transcription.

## Nemotron 3 speaker diarization

Nemotron 3 Diarization runs through `parakeet-transcription` and identifies up to
eight speakers, including overlapping activity. It returns speaker turns rather
than recognized words. For local weights:

```ts
const modelId = await loadModel({
  modelSrc: './Nemotron-3-Diarization.q8_0.gguf',
  modelType: 'parakeet-transcription'
})
const segments = await transcribe({ modelId, audioChunk: 'meeting.wav', metadata: true })
const turns = segments.flatMap(segment => segment.speakerSegments ?? [])
```

Each turn has zero-based `speakerId` and `startMs`/`endMs`. Configure
`diarizationThreshold` (0â€“1) and `diarizationMinSegmentMs` (a nonnegative integer)
at load or per stream in `parakeetStreamingConfig`; omit them to retain native
model defaults. Load with `streaming: true` before calling `transcribeStream`.
Enable `streamingSpeakerVad` at load or `emitSpeakerVad` per stream to receive
speaker-activity events. Streaming diarization metadata retains speaker IDs.

The CLI accepts MOSS `hotwords` and `max_new_tokens` in transcription requests.
Its `verbose_json` response includes MOSS speaker labels and Nemotron
`speaker_segments` with `speaker_id`, `start`, and `end` in seconds.

## Streaming with `transcribeStream()`

`transcribeStream()` opens a duplex session for both engines â€” write audio chunks via `session.write(...)`, iterate events with `for await (const event of session) { ... }`. Events are typed as a discriminated union `{ type }`:

* `{ type: "text", text }` â€” incremental transcript text.
* `{ type: "segment", segment }` â€” segment metadata when `metadata: true`, on both engines. Parakeet segments also carry `isEndOfTurn` and `startsWord`.
* `{ type: "vad", speaking, probability, source }` â€” voice-activity-detection state (whisper-only; `source` is `"silero"`).
* `{ type: "endOfTurn", source: "whisper", silenceDurationMs }` â€” turn boundary detected from a measured silence window (whisper).
* `{ type: "endOfTurn", source: "parakeet" }` â€” turn boundary detected from the EOU model's `<EOU>` token (parakeet; no silence window â€” the event is token-driven).

The `source` field on `endOfTurn` lets consumers narrow the union: whisper events always carry a numeric `silenceDurationMs`; parakeet events never do.

After the iterator completes, await `session.stats` to read terminal engine statistics. The promise resolves to `undefined` when the engine does not report stats.

```ts
for await (const event of session) {
  // Handle text, segment, VAD, or end-of-turn events.
}

const stats = await session.stats;
console.log(stats?.audioDuration, stats?.realTimeFactor);
```

<Callout type="info">
  **Wire compatibility:** post-0.6 servers emit `source` on every `endOfTurn` frame. SDK parsers still accept the legacy whisper wire shape `{ silenceDurationMs }` (no `source`) and normalize it to `source: "whisper"`. Upgrade client and server together when using parakeet `source: "parakeet"` events â€” older servers never emit that branch.
</Callout>

### Parakeet duplex streaming

Pass `parakeetStreamingConfig` to `transcribeStream()` to override per-call streaming knobs (each falls back to its `parakeetConfig.streaming*` load-time counterpart):

```ts
const session = await transcribeStream({
  modelId,
  parakeetStreamingConfig: {
    chunkMs: 1000,            // encoder cadence
    historyMs: 30000,         // sortformer rolling-history window
    leftContextMs: 500,       // ASR encoder left-context window
    rightLookaheadMs: 200,    // ASR encoder right-lookahead window
    emitPartials: true,       // emit partial segments before chunk boundaries
    emitEnergyVad: false,     // CTC/TDT energy-based VAD hint (engine-internal)
  },
});

for await (const event of session) {
  switch (event.type) {
    case "text":
      process.stdout.write(event.text);
      break;
    case "endOfTurn":
      // event.source: "whisper" | "parakeet"
      console.log("\n[endOfTurn] turn boundary detected\n");
      break;
  }
}
```

The synthetic `{ type: "endOfTurn", source: "parakeet" }` event surfaces whenever the EOU model emits an `<EOU>` token, and is the parakeet equivalent of whisper's silence-window EOU. Pair it with the `PARAKEET_EOU_120M_V1_Q8_0` checkpoint when you need explicit turn boundaries from parakeet.

  <Tab value="python" label="Python">
    <WrapCode>
      ```python file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk-python/examples/transcription.py title="transcription.py" lineNumbers
      """Python port of packages/sdk/examples/asr/whispercpp-filesystem.ts.

      Transcribe an audio file with per-segment metadata. `transcribe` is a
      server-stream: it yields `TranscribeResponse` frames; with `metadata=True`
      each carries a `segment` ({text, start_ms, end_ms, append, id}).

      Pass a 16 kHz mono WAV path, e.g. the SDK's own sample:
        python examples/transcription.py \
          ../sdk/examples/audio/sample-16khz.wav
      """

      from __future__ import annotations

      import asyncio
      import sys

      from tetherto.qvac_sdk import (
          Client,
          TranscribeRequest,
          load_model,
          transcribe,
          unload_model,
      )
      from tetherto.qvac_sdk.models import WHISPER_TINY


      def print_progress(p) -> None:
          """Print model download progress; pass as `on_progress=` to `load_model`."""
          line = (
              f"â–¸ Downloading {p.percentage:.0f}% "
              f"({p.downloaded / 1e6:.1f}/{p.total / 1e6:.1f} MB)"
          )
          print(line, end="\r" if sys.stderr.isatty() else "\n", file=sys.stderr)
          if p.percentage >= 100:
              print(file=sys.stderr)


      async def main() -> int:
          if len(sys.argv) < 2:
              print(
                  "Usage: python examples/transcription.py <wav-file-path>", file=sys.stderr
              )
              return 1
          audio_path = sys.argv[1]

          async with Client() as client:
              t = client.transport
              try:
                  print("â–¸ Loading Whisper model...")
                  model_id = await load_model(
                      t,
                      model_src=WHISPER_TINY,
                      model_config={"audio_format": "f32le", "language": "en"},
                      on_progress=print_progress,
                  )
                  print(f"â–¸ Whisper model loaded with ID: {model_id}")

                  print("â–¸ Transcribing audio...")
                  # audioChunk is a typed chunk, not a bare path: JS's transcribe
                  # wrapper turns a string into {type:"filePath"} for you, but Python
                  # calls the generated stub directly, so build the chunk explicitly.
                  request = TranscribeRequest.model_validate(
                      {
                          "type": "transcribe",
                          "modelId": model_id,
                          "audioChunk": {"type": "filePath", "value": audio_path},
                          "metadata": True,
                      }
                  )

                  segments = []
                  async for response in transcribe(t, request):
                      if response.segment is not None:
                          segments.append(response.segment)

                  print("â–¸ Transcription result:")
                  for seg in segments:
                      start = seg.start_ms / 1000
                      end = seg.end_ms / 1000
                      print(
                          f"  [{start:.2f}s â†’ {end:.2f}s] (id={seg.id}, append={seg.append}) {seg.text}"
                      )
                  print("\nFull transcript:", "".join(s.text for s in segments).strip())

                  print("â–¸ Unloading Whisper model...")
                  await unload_model(t, model_id)
              except Exception as error:
                  print(f"âœ– {error}", file=sys.stderr)
                  return 1
          return 0


      if __name__ == "__main__":
          sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))
      ```
    </WrapCode>
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

### Parakeet TDT

The following script shows an example of multilingual transcription using the Parakeet TDT model from a WAV file. Pass the path of a 16 kHz mono WAV file as the first argument; an optional second argument overrides the default model:

      ```js file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk/dist/examples/asr/parakeet-tdt-filesystem.js title="parakeet-tdt-filesystem.js" lineNumbers
      /**
       * Parakeet TDT transcription from a WAV file.
       *
       * Usage:
       *   npx tsx examples/asr/parakeet-tdt-filesystem.ts <wav-file> [parakeet-tdt-gguf]
       *
       * Loads a single GGUF checkpoint (`PARAKEET_TDT_0_6B_V3_Q8_0` by default) and
       * transcribes the file with the batch `transcribe` API. Omit the model
       * argument to use the registry constant.
       *
       * Audio should be 16 kHz mono PCM in a WAV container.
       */
      import { loadModel, unloadModel, transcribe, PARAKEET_TDT_0_6B_V3_Q8_0 } from '@qvac/sdk';
      const args = process.argv.slice(2);
      if (!args[0]) {
          console.error('Usage: npx tsx examples/asr/parakeet-tdt-filesystem.ts <wav-file-path> ' +
              '[parakeet-tdt-gguf]');
          console.error('\nIf the model path is omitted, defaults to the registry model.');
          process.exit(1);

      try {
          console.log('â–¸ Starting Parakeet transcription example...');
          console.log('â–¸ Loading Parakeet model...');
          const modelId = await loadModel({
              modelSrc: parakeetModelSrc,
              modelType: 'parakeet-transcription',
              onProgress: (p) => {
                  const mb = (n) => (n / 1e6).toFixed(1);
                  const line = `â–¸ Downloading ${p.percentage.toFixed(0)}% (${mb(p.downloaded)}/${mb(p.total)} MB)`;
                  process.stderr.write(process.stderr.isTTY ? `\r${line}` : `${line}\n`);
                  if (p.percentage >= 100)
                      process.stderr.write('\n');
              }
          });
          console.log(`â–¸ Parakeet model loaded with ID: ${modelId}`);
          console.log('â–¸ Transcribing audio...');
          const text = await transcribe({ modelId, audioChunk: audioFilePath });
          console.log(text);
          console.log('â–¸ Unloading Parakeet model...');
          await unloadModel({ modelId });
          console.log('â–¸ Parakeet model unloaded successfully');
      }
      catch (error) {
          console.error('âœ–', error);
          process.exit(1);
      }
      ```

      ```python file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk-python/examples/transcription_parakeet_tdt.py title="transcription_parakeet_tdt.py" lineNumbers
      """Python port of packages/sdk/examples/asr/parakeet-tdt-filesystem.ts.

      Parakeet TDT transcription from a WAV file. Loads a single GGUF checkpoint
      (`PARAKEET_TDT_0_6B_V3_Q8_0` by default) and transcribes the file with the
      batch `transcribe` API. Omit the model argument to use the registry constant.

      TypeScript's `transcribe()` returns the joined text. Python calls the worker
      directly, so `transcribe` yields `TranscribeResponse` frames and the example
      joins their `text` itself.

      Audio should be 16 kHz mono PCM in a WAV container.

      RUN: python examples/transcription_parakeet_tdt.py <wav-file> [parakeet-tdt-gguf]
      """

      from __future__ import annotations

      import asyncio
      import sys

      from tetherto.qvac_sdk import (
          Client,
          TranscribeRequest,
          load_model,
          transcribe,
          unload_model,
      )
      from tetherto.qvac_sdk.models import PARAKEET_TDT_0_6B_V3_Q8_0


      def print_progress(p) -> None:
          """Print model download progress; pass as `on_progress=` to `load_model`."""
          line = (
              f"â–¸ Downloading {p.percentage:.0f}% "
              f"({p.downloaded / 1e6:.1f}/{p.total / 1e6:.1f} MB)"
          )
          print(line, end="\r" if sys.stderr.isatty() else "\n", file=sys.stderr)
          if p.percentage >= 100:
              print(file=sys.stderr)


      async def main() -> int:
          if len(sys.argv) < 2:
              print(
                  "Usage: python examples/transcription_parakeet_tdt.py <wav-file-path> "
                  "[parakeet-tdt-gguf]",
                  file=sys.stderr,
              )
              print(
                  "\nIf the model path is omitted, defaults to the registry model.",
                  file=sys.stderr,
              )
              return 1
          audio_path = sys.argv[1]
          parakeet_model_src = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else PARAKEET_TDT_0_6B_V3_Q8_0

          async with Client() as client:
              t = client.transport
              try:
                  print("â–¸ Starting Parakeet transcription example...")

                  print("â–¸ Loading Parakeet model...")
                  model_id = await load_model(
                      t,
                      model_src=parakeet_model_src,
                      model_type="parakeet-transcription",
                      on_progress=print_progress,
                  )
                  print(f"â–¸ Parakeet model loaded with ID: {model_id}")

                  print("â–¸ Transcribing audio...")
                  # audioChunk is a typed chunk, not a bare path: JS's transcribe
                  # wrapper turns a string into {type:"filePath"} for you, but Python
                  # calls the generated stub directly, so build the chunk explicitly.
                  request = TranscribeRequest.model_validate(
                      {
                          "type": "transcribe",
                          "modelId": model_id,
                          "audioChunk": {"type": "filePath", "value": audio_path},
                      }
                  )

                  text = ""
                  async for response in transcribe(t, request):
                      if response.text:
                          text += response.text

                  print(text)

                  print("â–¸ Unloading Parakeet model...")
                  await unload_model(t, model_id)
                  print("â–¸ Parakeet model unloaded successfully")
              except Exception as error:
                  print(f"âœ– {error}", file=sys.stderr)
                  return 1
          return 0


      if __name__ == "__main__":
          sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))
      ```

### Parakeet Unified with Core ML

The following macOS script loads a regenerated Unified GGUF from disk, downloads its five Core ML encoder files through the registry, and transcribes a WAV file. Pass the path of the regenerated GGUF (`parakeet-unified-en-0.6b.{f16,q4_0,q8_0}.gguf`) as the first argument and the path of a 16 kHz mono WAV file as the second:

<Tabs>
  <Tab value="js" label="JavaScript" default>
    <WrapCode>
      ```js file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk/dist/examples/asr/parakeet-unified-coreml.js title="parakeet-unified-coreml.js" lineNumbers
      /**
       * Transcribe a WAV file with Parakeet Unified and its Core ML encoder sidecar.
       *
       * From packages/sdk:
       *   npx tsx examples/asr/parakeet-unified-coreml.ts \
       *     /path/to/parakeet-unified-en-0.6b.q4_0.gguf <16-kHz-wav-file>
       *
       * The GGUF must be a regenerated Unified artifact. The five compiled Core ML
       * files are downloaded through the SDK registry and staged beside the GGUF.
       */
      import { downloadAsset, getModelInfo, loadModel, transcribe, unloadModel } from '@qvac/sdk';
      import { link, mkdir, mkdtemp, open, rm, symlink } from 'node:fs/promises';
      import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
      import { basename, join, resolve } from 'node:path';
      const MODEL_STEM = 'parakeet-unified-en-0.6b';
      const COREML_FILES = [
          ['PARAKEET_UNIFIED_COREMLDATA', 'analytics/coremldata.bin'],
          ['PARAKEET_UNIFIED_COREMLDATA_1', 'coremldata.bin'],
          ['PARAKEET_UNIFIED_METADATA', 'metadata.json'],
          ['PARAKEET_UNIFIED_MODEL', 'model.mil'],
          ['PARAKEET_UNIFIED_WEIGHT', 'weights/weight.bin']
      ];
      const modelPath = process.argv[2];
      const audioPath = process.argv[3];
      async function checkModel(path) {
          const name = basename(path);
          if (!/^parakeet-unified-en-0\.6b\.(?:f16|q4_0|q8_0)\.gguf$/.test(name)) {
              throw new Error(`Expected a regenerated Unified GGUF, got: ${name}`);
          }
          const file = await open(path, 'r');
          try {
              const header = Buffer.alloc(1024 * 1024);
              const { bytesRead } = await file.read(header, 0, header.length, 0);
              if (!header.subarray(0, bytesRead).includes('parakeet.unified.left_context_frames')) {
                  throw new Error(`Unified GGUF lacks the new streaming metadata: ${path}`);
              }
          }
          finally {
              await file.close();
          }
      }
      async function stageModel(path) {
          if (process.platform !== 'darwin')
              throw new Error('Core ML requires macOS');
          await checkModel(path);
          const dir = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'qvac-unified-coreml-'));
          try {
              const modelSrc = join(dir, basename(path));
              await symlink(resolve(path), modelSrc);
              const bundleDir = join(dir, `${MODEL_STEM}-encoder.mlmodelc`);
              for (const [name, relativePath] of COREML_FILES) {
                  const info = await getModelInfo({ name });
                  if (!info.isCached) {
                      if (!info.registrySource || !info.registryPath) {
                          throw new Error(`Registry location missing for ${name}`);
                      }
                      console.log(`â–¸ Downloading Core ML ${relativePath}...`);
                      await downloadAsset({ assetSrc: `registry://${info.registrySource}/${info.registryPath}` });
                  }
                  const cached = await getModelInfo({ name });
                  const sourcePath = cached.cacheFiles.find((file) => file.isCached)?.path;
                  if (!sourcePath)
                      throw new Error(`Core ML file is missing from the SDK cache: ${name}`);
                  const targetPath = join(bundleDir, relativePath);
                  await mkdir(join(targetPath, '..'), { recursive: true });
                  await link(sourcePath, targetPath);
              }
              return { modelSrc, dir };
          }
          catch (error) {
              await rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
              throw error;
          }
      }
      async function main() {
          if (!modelPath || !audioPath) {
              throw new Error('Usage: npx tsx examples/asr/parakeet-unified-coreml.ts ' +
                  '<regenerated-unified-gguf> <16-kHz-wav-file>');
          }
          let staged;
          let modelId;
          try {
              staged = await stageModel(modelPath);
              console.log('â–¸ Loading Parakeet Unified with its Core ML encoder sidecar...');
              modelId = await loadModel({
                  modelSrc: staged.modelSrc,
                  modelType: 'parakeet-transcription',
                  modelConfig: { useGPU: true }
              });
              console.log('â–¸ Transcribing audio...');
              const text = await transcribe({ modelId, audioChunk: audioPath });
              if (!text.trim())
                  throw new Error('Parakeet Unified returned an empty transcription');
              console.log(text);
          }
          finally {
              try {
                  if (modelId)
                      await unloadModel({ modelId });
              }
              finally {
                  if (staged)
                      await rm(staged.dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
              }
          }
      }
      main().catch((error) => {
          console.error('âœ–', error);
          process.exitCode = 1;
      });
      ```

    <WrapCode>
      ```ts file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk/examples/asr/parakeet-unified-coreml.ts title="parakeet-unified-coreml.ts" lineNumbers
      /**
       * Transcribe a WAV file with Parakeet Unified and its Core ML encoder sidecar.
       *
       * From packages/sdk:
       *   npx tsx examples/asr/parakeet-unified-coreml.ts \
       *     /path/to/parakeet-unified-en-0.6b.q4_0.gguf <16-kHz-wav-file>
       *
       * The GGUF must be a regenerated Unified artifact. The five compiled Core ML
       * files are downloaded through the SDK registry and staged beside the GGUF.
       */
      import { downloadAsset, getModelInfo, loadModel, transcribe, unloadModel } from '@qvac/sdk'
      import { link, mkdir, mkdtemp, open, rm, symlink } from 'node:fs/promises'
      import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
      import { basename, join, resolve } from 'node:path'

      const MODEL_STEM = 'parakeet-unified-en-0.6b'
      const COREML_FILES = [
        ['PARAKEET_UNIFIED_COREMLDATA', 'analytics/coremldata.bin'],
        ['PARAKEET_UNIFIED_COREMLDATA_1', 'coremldata.bin'],
        ['PARAKEET_UNIFIED_METADATA', 'metadata.json'],
        ['PARAKEET_UNIFIED_MODEL', 'model.mil'],
        ['PARAKEET_UNIFIED_WEIGHT', 'weights/weight.bin']
      ] as const

      const modelPath = process.argv[2]
      const audioPath = process.argv[3]

      async function checkModel(path: string): Promise<void> {
        const name = basename(path)
        if (!/^parakeet-unified-en-0\.6b\.(?:f16|q4_0|q8_0)\.gguf$/.test(name)) {
          throw new Error(`Expected a regenerated Unified GGUF, got: ${name}`)
        }

        const file = await open(path, 'r')
        try {
          const header = Buffer.alloc(1024 * 1024)
          const { bytesRead } = await file.read(header, 0, header.length, 0)
          if (!header.subarray(0, bytesRead).includes('parakeet.unified.left_context_frames')) {
            throw new Error(`Unified GGUF lacks the new streaming metadata: ${path}`)
          }
        } finally {
          await file.close()
        }
      }

      async function stageModel(path: string): Promise<{ modelSrc: string; dir: string }> {
        if (process.platform !== 'darwin') throw new Error('Core ML requires macOS')
        await checkModel(path)

        const dir = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'qvac-unified-coreml-'))
        try {
          const modelSrc = join(dir, basename(path))
          await symlink(resolve(path), modelSrc)
          const bundleDir = join(dir, `${MODEL_STEM}-encoder.mlmodelc`)

          for (const [name, relativePath] of COREML_FILES) {
            const info = await getModelInfo({ name })
            if (!info.isCached) {
              if (!info.registrySource || !info.registryPath) {
                throw new Error(`Registry location missing for ${name}`)
              }
              console.log(`â–¸ Downloading Core ML ${relativePath}...`)
              await downloadAsset({ assetSrc: `registry://${info.registrySource}/${info.registryPath}` })
            }

            const cached = await getModelInfo({ name })
            const sourcePath = cached.cacheFiles.find((file) => file.isCached)?.path
            if (!sourcePath) throw new Error(`Core ML file is missing from the SDK cache: ${name}`)

            const targetPath = join(bundleDir, relativePath)
            await mkdir(join(targetPath, '..'), { recursive: true })
            await link(sourcePath, targetPath)
          }

          return { modelSrc, dir }
        } catch (error) {
          await rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })
          throw error
        }
      }

      async function main(): Promise<void> {
        if (!modelPath || !audioPath) {
          throw new Error(
            'Usage: npx tsx examples/asr/parakeet-unified-coreml.ts ' +
              '<regenerated-unified-gguf> <16-kHz-wav-file>'
          )
        }

        let staged: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof stageModel>> | undefined
        let modelId: string | undefined
        try {
          staged = await stageModel(modelPath)
          console.log('â–¸ Loading Parakeet Unified with its Core ML encoder sidecar...')
          modelId = await loadModel({
            modelSrc: staged.modelSrc,
            modelType: 'parakeet-transcription',
            modelConfig: { useGPU: true }
          })

          console.log('â–¸ Transcribing audio...')
          const text = await transcribe({ modelId, audioChunk: audioPath })
          if (!text.trim()) throw new Error('Parakeet Unified returned an empty transcription')
          console.log(text)
        } finally {
          try {
            if (modelId) await unloadModel({ modelId })
          } finally {
            if (staged) await rm(staged.dir, { recursive: true, force: true })
          }
        }
      }

      main().catch((error: unknown) => {
        console.error('âœ–', error)
        process.exitCode = 1
      })
      ```

      ```python file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk-python/examples/transcription_parakeet_unified_coreml.py title="transcription_parakeet_unified_coreml.py" lineNumbers
      """Python port of packages/sdk/examples/asr/parakeet-unified-coreml.ts.

      Transcribe a WAV file with Parakeet Unified and its Core ML encoder sidecar
      (macOS only). The GGUF must be a regenerated Unified artifact. The five
      compiled Core ML files are downloaded through the SDK registry and staged
      beside the GGUF in a temporary directory, which is removed afterwards.

      TypeScript's `transcribe()` returns the joined text. Python calls the worker
      directly, so `transcribe` yields `TranscribeResponse` frames and the example
      joins their `text` itself. `get_model_info` and `download_asset` are generated
      stubs, so each takes its request model.

      RUN: python examples/transcription_parakeet_unified_coreml.py <regenerated-unified-gguf> <16-kHz-wav-file>
      """

      from __future__ import annotations

      import asyncio
      import os
      import re
      import shutil
      import sys
      import tempfile
      from pathlib import Path

      from tetherto.qvac_sdk import (
          Client,
          DownloadAssetRequest,
          GetModelInfoRequest,
          TranscribeRequest,
          download_asset,
          get_model_info,
          load_model,
          transcribe,
          unload_model,
      )

      MODEL_STEM = "parakeet-unified-en-0.6b"
      COREML_FILES = [
          ("PARAKEET_UNIFIED_COREMLDATA", "analytics/coremldata.bin"),
          ("PARAKEET_UNIFIED_COREMLDATA_1", "coremldata.bin"),
          ("PARAKEET_UNIFIED_METADATA", "metadata.json"),
          ("PARAKEET_UNIFIED_MODEL", "model.mil"),
          ("PARAKEET_UNIFIED_WEIGHT", "weights/weight.bin"),
      ]


      def check_model(path: Path) -> None:
          if not re.fullmatch(
              r"parakeet-unified-en-0\.6b\.(?:f16|q4_0|q8_0)\.gguf", path.name
          ):
              raise ValueError(f"Expected a regenerated Unified GGUF, got: {path.name}")

          with path.open("rb") as file:
              header = file.read(1024 * 1024)
          if b"parakeet.unified.left_context_frames" not in header:
              raise ValueError(f"Unified GGUF lacks the new streaming metadata: {path}")


      async def fetch_info(t, name: str):
          request = GetModelInfoRequest.model_validate({"type": "getModelInfo", "name": name})
          return (await get_model_info(t, request)).model_info


      async def stage_model(t, path: Path) -> tuple[str, Path]:
          if sys.platform != "darwin":
              raise RuntimeError("Core ML requires macOS")
          check_model(path)

          staging_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="qvac-unified-coreml-"))
          try:
              model_src = staging_dir / path.name
              model_src.symlink_to(path.resolve())
              bundle_dir = staging_dir / f"{MODEL_STEM}-encoder.mlmodelc"

              for name, relative_path in COREML_FILES:
                  info = await fetch_info(t, name)
                  if not info.is_cached:
                      if not info.registry_source or not info.registry_path:
                          raise RuntimeError(f"Registry location missing for {name}")
                      print(f"â–¸ Downloading Core ML {relative_path}...")
                      request = DownloadAssetRequest.model_validate(
                          {
                              "type": "downloadAsset",
                              "assetSrc": f"registry://{info.registry_source}/{info.registry_path}",
                          }
                      )
                      await download_asset(t, request)

                  cached = await fetch_info(t, name)
                  source_path = next(
                      (file.path for file in cached.cache_files or [] if file.is_cached), None
                  )
                  if not source_path:
                      raise RuntimeError(
                          f"Core ML file is missing from the SDK cache: {name}"
                      )

                  target_path = bundle_dir / relative_path
                  target_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                  os.link(source_path, target_path)

              return str(model_src), staging_dir
          except BaseException:
              shutil.rmtree(staging_dir, ignore_errors=True)
              raise


      async def main() -> int:
          if len(sys.argv) < 3:
              print(
                  "Usage: python examples/transcription_parakeet_unified_coreml.py "
                  "<regenerated-unified-gguf> <16-kHz-wav-file>",
                  file=sys.stderr,
              )
              return 1
          model_path = Path(sys.argv[1])
          audio_path = sys.argv[2]

          async with Client() as client:
              t = client.transport
              staging_dir = None
              model_id = None
              try:
                  model_src, staging_dir = await stage_model(t, model_path)
                  print("â–¸ Loading Parakeet Unified with its Core ML encoder sidecar...")
                  model_id = await load_model(
                      t,
                      model_src=model_src,
                      model_type="parakeet-transcription",
                      model_config={"useGPU": True},
                  )

                  print("â–¸ Transcribing audio...")
                  # audioChunk is a typed chunk, not a bare path: JS's transcribe
                  # wrapper turns a string into {type:"filePath"} for you, but Python
                  # calls the generated stub directly, so build the chunk explicitly.
                  request = TranscribeRequest.model_validate(
                      {
                          "type": "transcribe",
                          "modelId": model_id,
                          "audioChunk": {"type": "filePath", "value": audio_path},
                      }
                  )

                  text = ""
                  async for response in transcribe(t, request):
                      if response.text:
                          text += response.text

                  if not text.strip():
                      raise RuntimeError("Parakeet Unified returned an empty transcription")
                  print(text)
              except Exception as error:
                  print(f"âœ– {error}", file=sys.stderr)
                  return 1
              finally:
                  try:
                      if model_id is not None:
                          await unload_model(t, model_id)
                  finally:
                      if staging_dir is not None:
                          shutil.rmtree(staging_dir, ignore_errors=True)
          return 0


      if __name__ == "__main__":
          sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))
      ```

### TranscribePsy

The following script transcribes a file with TranscribePsy. By default it loads the ggml GGUF; on macOS, `--coreml` loads the Core ML distribution and reports whether the encoder ran on the Neural Engine, and `--window-sec` sets an explicit long-form window. Pass the path of the audio file as the first argument:

<Tabs>
  <Tab value="js" label="JavaScript" default>
    <WrapCode>
      ```js file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk/dist/examples/asr/parakeet-transcribepsy-filesystem.js title="parakeet-transcribepsy-filesystem.js" lineNumbers
      /**
       * TranscribePsy transcription from an audio file.
       *
       * Usage:
       *   npx tsx examples/asr/parakeet-transcribepsy-filesystem.ts <audio-file> [--coreml] [--window-sec <seconds>]
       *
       * TranscribePsy-250M-EU-sub is a 254M Parakeet-TDT distilled for Dutch,
       * English, French, German, Italian, Polish, Portuguese and Spanish; the engine
       * detects the language, so there is nothing to set. The default constant
       * (`PARAKEET_TRANSCRIBEPSY_250M_Q8_0`) runs on ggml everywhere. On
       * macOS and iOS, `--coreml` loads the Core ML distribution instead
       * (`PARAKEET_TRANSCRIBEPSY_250M_COREML_Q8_0`): the SDK downloads its
       * encoder and decoder bundles with the GGUF, and both stages run on the Neural
       * Engine. Anywhere else that constant is refused at load time.
       *
       * Long recordings are encoded in overlapping windows, so memory stays flat
       * however long the file is. Without `--window-sec` the engine uses the 60 s
       * windows with 25 % overlap the model recommends; an explicit window is sent
       * as encoder frames (12.5 per second) with a quarter of it as context, which
       * is how a phone with little memory can trade speed for a smaller footprint.
       */
      import { loadModel, unloadModel, transcribe, PARAKEET_TRANSCRIBEPSY_250M_Q8_0, PARAKEET_TRANSCRIBEPSY_250M_COREML_Q8_0 } from '@qvac/sdk';
      const ENCODER_FRAMES_PER_SECOND = 12.5;
      const RECOMMENDED_OVERLAP = 0.25;
      const args = process.argv.slice(2);
      const audioFilePath = args.find((arg) => !arg.startsWith('--'));
      const useCoreml = args.includes('--coreml');
      const windowIndex = args.indexOf('--window-sec');
      const windowSeconds = windowIndex === -1 ? undefined : Number(args[windowIndex + 1]);
      if (!audioFilePath || (windowSeconds !== undefined && !(windowSeconds > 0))) {
          console.error('Usage: npx tsx examples/asr/parakeet-transcribepsy-filesystem.ts <audio-file> ' +
              '[--coreml] [--window-sec <seconds>]');
          process.exit(1);
      }
      // An explicit window becomes the engine's frame counts; the overlap is shared
      // half and half with each neighbouring window.
      const longForm = windowSeconds === undefined
          ? {}
          : {
              longFormWindowFrames: Math.round(windowSeconds * ENCODER_FRAMES_PER_SECOND),
              longFormContextFrames: Math.round((windowSeconds * ENCODER_FRAMES_PER_SECOND * RECOMMENDED_OVERLAP) / 2)
          };
      const modelSrc = useCoreml
          ? PARAKEET_TRANSCRIBEPSY_250M_COREML_Q8_0
          : PARAKEET_TRANSCRIBEPSY_250M_Q8_0;
      try {
          console.log(`â–¸ Loading TranscribePsy (${useCoreml ? 'Core ML distribution' : 'ggml'})...`);
          const modelId = await loadModel({
              modelSrc,
              modelType: 'parakeet-transcription',
              modelConfig: longForm,
              onProgress: (p) => {
                  const mb = (n) => (n / 1e6).toFixed(1);
                  const line = `â–¸ Downloading ${p.percentage.toFixed(0)}% (${mb(p.downloaded)}/${mb(p.total)} MB)`;
                  process.stderr.write(process.stderr.isTTY ? `\r${line}` : `${line}\n`);
                  if (p.percentage >= 100)
                      process.stderr.write('\n');
              }
          });
          console.log(windowSeconds === undefined
              ? 'â–¸ Transcribing with the windows the model recommends (60 s, 25 % overlap)...'
              : `â–¸ Transcribing in ${windowSeconds} s windows...`);
          const call = transcribe({ modelId, audioChunk: audioFilePath });
          const text = await call;
          const stats = await call.stats;
          console.log(text);
          if (stats) {
              console.log(`â–¸ ${stats.audioDuration?.toFixed(1) ?? '?'} s of audio, real-time factor ${stats.realTimeFactor?.toFixed(3) ?? '?'}` +
                  (useCoreml ? `, encoder on Core ML: ${stats.encoderUsedCoreml === 1 ? 'yes' : 'no'}` : ''));
          }
          await unloadModel({ modelId });
      }
      catch (error) {
          console.error('âœ–', error);
          process.exit(1);
      }
      ```

      ```ts file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk/examples/asr/parakeet-transcribepsy-filesystem.ts title="parakeet-transcribepsy-filesystem.ts" lineNumbers
       * TranscribePsy-250M-EU-sub is a 254M Parakeet-TDT distilled for Dutch,
      ```

      ```python file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk-python/examples/transcription_parakeet_transcribepsy.py title="transcription_parakeet_transcribepsy.py" lineNumbers
      """Python port of packages/sdk/examples/asr/parakeet-transcribepsy-filesystem.ts.

      TranscribePsy transcription from an audio file.

      TranscribePsy-250M-EU-sub is a 254M Parakeet-TDT distilled for Dutch,
      English, French, German, Italian, Polish, Portuguese and Spanish; the engine
      detects the language, so there is nothing to set. The default constant
      (`PARAKEET_TRANSCRIBEPSY_250M_Q8_0`) runs on ggml everywhere. On macOS and
      iOS, `--coreml` loads the Core ML distribution instead
      (`PARAKEET_TRANSCRIBEPSY_250M_COREML_Q8_0`): the SDK downloads its encoder and
      decoder bundles with the GGUF, and both stages run on the Neural Engine.
      Anywhere else that constant is refused at load time.

      Long recordings are encoded in overlapping windows, so memory stays flat
      however long the file is. Without `--window-sec` the engine uses the 60 s
      windows with 25 % overlap the model recommends; an explicit window is sent as
      encoder frames (12.5 per second) with a quarter of it as context, which is how
      a phone with little memory can trade speed for a smaller footprint.

      TypeScript's `transcribe()` returns the joined text and exposes `stats`
      separately. Python calls the worker directly, so `transcribe` yields
      `TranscribeResponse` frames: the example joins their `text` and reads `stats`
      off the closing frame.

      RUN: python examples/transcription_parakeet_transcribepsy.py <audio-file> [--coreml] [--window-sec <seconds>]
      """

      from __future__ import annotations

      import asyncio
      import sys

      from tetherto.qvac_sdk import (
          Client,
          TranscribeRequest,
          load_model,
          transcribe,
          unload_model,
      )
      from tetherto.qvac_sdk.models import (
          PARAKEET_TRANSCRIBEPSY_250M_COREML_Q8_0,
          PARAKEET_TRANSCRIBEPSY_250M_Q8_0,
      )

      ENCODER_FRAMES_PER_SECOND = 12.5
      RECOMMENDED_OVERLAP = 0.25
      USAGE = (
          "Usage: python examples/transcription_parakeet_transcribepsy.py <audio-file> "
          "[--coreml] [--window-sec <seconds>]"
      )


      def print_progress(p) -> None:
          """Print model download progress; pass as `on_progress=` to `load_model`."""
          line = (
              f"â–¸ Downloading {p.percentage:.0f}% "
              f"({p.downloaded / 1e6:.1f}/{p.total / 1e6:.1f} MB)"
          )
          print(line, end="\r" if sys.stderr.isatty() else "\n", file=sys.stderr)
          if p.percentage >= 100:
              print(file=sys.stderr)


      def fmt(value: float | None, digits: int) -> str:
          """Format an optional stat, as TypeScript's `?.toFixed(n) ?? '?'`."""
          return "?" if value is None else f"{value:.{digits}f}"


      def parse_args(args: list[str]) -> tuple[str, bool, float | None] | None:
          audio_path = next((arg for arg in args if not arg.startswith("--")), None)
          use_coreml = "--coreml" in args
          window_seconds = None
          if "--window-sec" in args:
              index = args.index("--window-sec")
              try:
                  window_seconds = float(args[index + 1])
              except (IndexError, ValueError):
                  return None
              if not window_seconds > 0:
                  return None
          if audio_path is None:
              return None
          return audio_path, use_coreml, window_seconds


      async def main() -> int:
          parsed = parse_args(sys.argv[1:])
          if parsed is None:
              print(USAGE, file=sys.stderr)
              return 1
          audio_path, use_coreml, window_seconds = parsed

          # An explicit window becomes the engine's frame counts; the overlap is
          # shared half and half with each neighbouring window.
          long_form = (
              {}
              if window_seconds is None
              else {
                  "longFormWindowFrames": round(window_seconds * ENCODER_FRAMES_PER_SECOND),
                  "longFormContextFrames": round(
                      window_seconds * ENCODER_FRAMES_PER_SECOND * RECOMMENDED_OVERLAP / 2
                  ),
              }
          )

          model_src = (
              PARAKEET_TRANSCRIBEPSY_250M_COREML_Q8_0
              if use_coreml
              else PARAKEET_TRANSCRIBEPSY_250M_Q8_0
          )

          async with Client() as client:
              t = client.transport
              try:
                  backend = "Core ML distribution" if use_coreml else "ggml"
                  print(f"â–¸ Loading TranscribePsy ({backend})...")
                  model_id = await load_model(
                      t,
                      model_src=model_src,
                      model_type="parakeet-transcription",
                      model_config=long_form,
                      on_progress=print_progress,
                  )

                  print(
                      "â–¸ Transcribing with the windows the model recommends (60 s, 25 % overlap)..."
                      if window_seconds is None
                      else f"â–¸ Transcribing in {window_seconds:g} s windows..."
                  )
                  # audioChunk is a typed chunk, not a bare path: JS's transcribe
                  # wrapper turns a string into {type:"filePath"} for you, but Python
                  # calls the generated stub directly, so build the chunk explicitly.
                  request = TranscribeRequest.model_validate(
                      {
                          "type": "transcribe",
                          "modelId": model_id,
                          "audioChunk": {"type": "filePath", "value": audio_path},
                      }
                  )

                  text = ""
                  stats = None
                  async for response in transcribe(t, request):
                      if response.text:
                          text += response.text
                      if response.stats is not None:
                          stats = response.stats

                  print(text)
                  if stats is not None:
                      summary = (
                          f"â–¸ {fmt(stats.audio_duration, 1)} s of audio, "
                          f"real-time factor {fmt(stats.real_time_factor, 3)}"
                      )
                      if use_coreml:
                          used = "yes" if stats.encoder_used_coreml == 1 else "no"
                          summary += f", encoder on Core ML: {used}"
                      print(summary)

                  await unload_model(t, model_id)
              except Exception as error:
                  print(f"âœ– {error}", file=sys.stderr)
                  return 1
          return 0


      if __name__ == "__main__":
          sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))
      ```

### Parakeet Indic Conformer

The following script shows an example of Indic-language transcription using the Parakeet Indic Conformer CTC model from a WAV file. Pass the path of a 16 kHz mono WAV file as the first argument and the audio's language code (e.g., `hi`, `ta`) as the second; the language is required. An optional third argument overrides the default model:

<Tabs>
  <Tab value="js" label="JavaScript" default>
    <WrapCode>
      ```js file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk/dist/examples/asr/parakeet-indic-conformer-filesystem.js title="parakeet-indic-conformer-filesystem.js" lineNumbers
      /**
       * Indic Conformer CTC transcription from a WAV file.
       *
       * Usage:
       *   npx tsx examples/asr/parakeet-indic-conformer-filesystem.ts <wav-file> <language> [gguf]
       *
       * Loads a single GGUF checkpoint (`PARAKEET_INDIC_CONFORMER_600M_Q8_0` by
       * default) and transcribes with the batch `transcribe` API. `language` is
       * required (e.g. `hi`, `ta`) because Indic Conformer CTC masks the vocab
       * with `parakeet.ctc.lang_*` ranges. English Parakeet CTC ignores this field.
       *
       * Audio should be 16 kHz mono PCM in a WAV container.
       */
      import { loadModel, unloadModel, transcribe, PARAKEET_INDIC_CONFORMER_600M_Q8_0 } from '@qvac/sdk';
      const args = process.argv.slice(2);
      if (!args[0] || !args[1]) {
          console.error('Usage: npx tsx examples/asr/parakeet-indic-conformer-filesystem.ts ' +
              '<wav-file> <language> [indic-conformer-gguf]');
          console.error('\nExample: ... filesystem.ts speech.wav hi');
          console.error('If the model path is omitted, defaults to the registry model.');
          process.exit(1);
      }
      const audioFilePath = args[0];
      const language = args[1];
      const parakeetModelSrc = args[2] ?? PARAKEET_INDIC_CONFORMER_600M_Q8_0;
      try {
          console.log('â–¸ Loading Indic Conformer CTC model...');
          const modelId = await loadModel({
              modelSrc: parakeetModelSrc,
              modelType: 'parakeet-transcription',
              modelConfig: { language },
              onProgress: (p) => {
                  const mb = (n) => (n / 1e6).toFixed(1);
                  const line = `â–¸ Downloading ${p.percentage.toFixed(0)}% (${mb(p.downloaded)}/${mb(p.total)} MB)`;
                  process.stderr.write(process.stderr.isTTY ? `\r${line}` : `${line}\n`);
                  if (p.percentage >= 100)
                      process.stderr.write('\n');
              }
          });
          console.log(`â–¸ Indic Conformer CTC model loaded with ID: ${modelId}`);
          console.log(`â–¸ Language: ${language}`);
          console.log('â–¸ Transcribing audio...');
          const text = await transcribe({ modelId, audioChunk: audioFilePath });
          console.log(text);
          console.log('â–¸ Unloading model...');
          await unloadModel({ modelId });
          console.log('â–¸ Done');
      }
      catch (error) {
          console.error('âœ–', error);
          process.exit(1);
      }
      ```

      ```python file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk-python/examples/transcription_parakeet_indic_conformer.py title="transcription_parakeet_indic_conformer.py" lineNumbers
      """Python port of packages/sdk/examples/asr/parakeet-indic-conformer-filesystem.ts.

      Indic Conformer CTC transcription from a WAV file. Loads a single GGUF
      checkpoint (`PARAKEET_INDIC_CONFORMER_600M_Q8_0` by default) and transcribes
      with the batch `transcribe` API. `language` is required (e.g. `hi`, `ta`)
      because Indic Conformer CTC masks the vocab with `parakeet.ctc.lang_*` ranges.
      English Parakeet CTC ignores this field.

      TypeScript's `transcribe()` returns the joined text. Python calls the worker
      directly, so `transcribe` yields `TranscribeResponse` frames and the example
      joins their `text` itself.

      Audio should be 16 kHz mono PCM in a WAV container.

      RUN: python examples/transcription_parakeet_indic_conformer.py <wav-file> <language> [indic-conformer-gguf]
      """

      from __future__ import annotations

      import asyncio
      import sys

      from tetherto.qvac_sdk import (
          Client,
          TranscribeRequest,
          load_model,
          transcribe,
          unload_model,
      )
      from tetherto.qvac_sdk.models import PARAKEET_INDIC_CONFORMER_600M_Q8_0


      def print_progress(p) -> None:
          """Print model download progress; pass as `on_progress=` to `load_model`."""
          line = (
              f"â–¸ Downloading {p.percentage:.0f}% "
              f"({p.downloaded / 1e6:.1f}/{p.total / 1e6:.1f} MB)"
          )
          print(line, end="\r" if sys.stderr.isatty() else "\n", file=sys.stderr)
          if p.percentage >= 100:
              print(file=sys.stderr)


      async def main() -> int:
          if len(sys.argv) < 3:
              print(
                  "Usage: python examples/transcription_parakeet_indic_conformer.py "
                  "<wav-file> <language> [indic-conformer-gguf]",
                  file=sys.stderr,
              )
              print(
                  "\nExample: ... transcription_parakeet_indic_conformer.py speech.wav hi",
                  file=sys.stderr,
              )
              print(
                  "If the model path is omitted, defaults to the registry model.",
                  file=sys.stderr,
              )
              return 1
          audio_path = sys.argv[1]
          language = sys.argv[2]
          parakeet_model_src = (
              sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else PARAKEET_INDIC_CONFORMER_600M_Q8_0
          )

          async with Client() as client:
              t = client.transport
              try:
                  print("â–¸ Loading Indic Conformer CTC model...")
                  model_id = await load_model(
                      t,
                      model_src=parakeet_model_src,
                      model_type="parakeet-transcription",
                      model_config={"language": language},
                      on_progress=print_progress,
                  )
                  print(f"â–¸ Indic Conformer CTC model loaded with ID: {model_id}")
                  print(f"â–¸ Language: {language}")

                  print("â–¸ Transcribing audio...")
                  # audioChunk is a typed chunk, not a bare path: JS's transcribe
                  # wrapper turns a string into {type:"filePath"} for you, but Python
                  # calls the generated stub directly, so build the chunk explicitly.
                  request = TranscribeRequest.model_validate(
                      {
                          "type": "transcribe",
                          "modelId": model_id,
                          "audioChunk": {"type": "filePath", "value": audio_path},
                      }
                  )

                  text = ""
                  async for response in transcribe(t, request):
                      if response.text:
                          text += response.text

                  print(text)

                  print("â–¸ Unloading model...")
                  await unload_model(t, model_id)
                  print("â–¸ Done")
              except Exception as error:
                  print(f"âœ– {error}", file=sys.stderr)
                  return 1
          return 0


      if __name__ == "__main__":
          sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))
      ```

### Parakeet Sortformer

The following script shows an example of speaker diarization using the Parakeet Sortformer model, followed by per-segment transcription with the TDT model. Pass the path of a 16 kHz mono 16-bit WAV file as the first argument; an optional second argument overrides the default Sortformer model. To try it with a multi-speaker recording, download [`diarization-sample-16k.wav`](https://github.com/tetherto/qvac/blob/main/packages/sdk/examples/audio/diarization-sample-16k.wav) next to the example and pass its path:

<Tabs>
  <Tab value="js" label="JavaScript" default>
    <WrapCode>
      ```js file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk/dist/examples/asr/parakeet-sortformer.js title="parakeet-sortformer.js" lineNumbers
      /**
       * Parakeet Sortformer diarization + TDT transcription pipeline.
       *
       * Usage:
       *   npx tsx examples/asr/parakeet-sortformer.ts <wav-file> [sortformer-gguf]
       *
       * Two-step flow: Sortformer v2.1 diarizes the audio, then TDT transcribes each
       * speaker segment. Defaults to registry GGUFs. For live streaming + AOSC, see
       * `parakeet-sortformer-streaming.ts`.
       *
       * Audio should be 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM in a WAV container. A multi-speaker
       * sample is in the QVAC source repo but not the published npm package:
       *   https://github.com/tetherto/qvac/blob/main/packages/sdk/examples/audio/diarization-sample-16k.wav
       */
      import { loadModel, unloadModel, transcribe, PARAKEET_TDT_0_6B_V3_Q8_0, PARAKEET_SORTFORMER_4SPK_V2_1_Q8_0 } from '@qvac/sdk';
      import { join } from 'path';
      import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'fs';
      import { tmpdir } from 'os';
      const args = process.argv.slice(2);
      if (!args[0]) {
          console.error('Usage: npx tsx examples/asr/parakeet-sortformer.ts <wav-file> [sortformer-gguf]');
          console.error('\nIf the model path is omitted, defaults to the registry model.');
          process.exit(1);
      }
      const audioFilePath = args[0];
      const sortformerSrc = args[1] ?? PARAKEET_SORTFORMER_4SPK_V2_1_Q8_0;
      try {
          // â”€â”€ Step 1: Diarize with Sortformer â”€â”€
          const sfModelId = await loadModel({
              modelSrc: sortformerSrc,
              modelType: 'parakeet-transcription'
          });
          const diarization = await transcribe({
              modelId: sfModelId,
              audioChunk: audioFilePath
          });
          await unloadModel({ modelId: sfModelId });
          const segments = parseDiarization(diarization);
          // â”€â”€ Step 2: Transcribe each segment with TDT â”€â”€
          const tdtModelId = await loadModel({
              modelSrc: PARAKEET_TDT_0_6B_V3_Q8_0
          });
          const pcm = readPcm(audioFilePath);
          const sliceDir = join(tmpdir(), `qvac-diarize-${Date.now()}`);
          mkdirSync(sliceDir, { recursive: true });
          const results = [];
          for (let i = 0; i < segments.length; i++) {
              const seg = segments[i];
              const slicePath = join(sliceDir, `seg-${i}.wav`);
              if (!writeWavSlice(pcm, seg.start, seg.end, slicePath)) {
                  results.push({ ...seg, text: '[No speech detected]' });
                  continue;
              }
              const text = await transcribe({
                  modelId: tdtModelId,
                  audioChunk: slicePath
              });
              results.push({ ...seg, text: text.trim() || '[No speech detected]' });
          }
          await unloadModel({ modelId: tdtModelId });
          // â”€â”€ Step 3: Merge consecutive same-speaker segments and print â”€â”€
          const merged = mergeSpeakers(results);
          console.log('\nâ–¸ Diarized transcription');
          for (const entry of merged) {
              console.log(`Speaker ${entry.speaker} (${entry.start.toFixed(2)}s - ${entry.end.toFixed(2)}s):`);
              console.log(`  ${entry.text}\n`);
          }
          console.log('â–¸ Done');
      }
      catch (error) {
          console.error('âœ–', error);
          process.exit(1);
      }
      // â”€â”€ Helpers â”€â”€
      function parseDiarization(text) {
          const segs = [];
          for (const line of text.split('\n')) {
              const m = line.match(/Speaker (\d+): ([\d.]+)s - ([\d.]+)s/);
              if (m)
                  segs.push({ speaker: +m[1], start: +m[2], end: +m[3] });
          }
          return segs.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
      }
      function readPcm(wavPath) {
          const buf = readFileSync(wavPath);
          const dataOffset = buf.indexOf('data') + 4;
          return buf.subarray(dataOffset + 4, dataOffset + 4 + buf.readUInt32LE(dataOffset));
      }
      function writeWavSlice(pcm, startSec, endSec, outPath) {
          const SR = 16000;
          const BPS = 2;
          const startByte = Math.floor(startSec * SR) * BPS;
          const endByte = Math.min(Math.ceil(endSec * SR) * BPS, pcm.length);
          if (startByte >= endByte)
              return false;
          const slice = pcm.subarray(startByte, endByte);
          const hdr = Buffer.alloc(44);
          hdr.write('RIFF', 0);
          hdr.writeUInt32LE(36 + slice.length, 4);
          hdr.write('WAVEfmt ', 8);
          hdr.writeUInt32LE(16, 16);
          hdr.writeUInt16LE(1, 20);
          hdr.writeUInt16LE(1, 22);
          hdr.writeUInt32LE(SR, 24);
          hdr.writeUInt32LE(SR * BPS, 28);
          hdr.writeUInt16LE(BPS, 32);
          hdr.writeUInt16LE(16, 34);
          hdr.write('data', 36);
          hdr.writeUInt32LE(slice.length, 40);
          writeFileSync(outPath, Buffer.concat([hdr, slice]));
          return true;
      }
      function mergeSpeakers(entries) {
          const out = [];
          for (const e of entries) {
              const last = out[out.length - 1];
              if (last && last.speaker === e.speaker) {
                  last.text += ' ' + e.text;
                  last.end = e.end;
              }
              else {
                  out.push({ ...e });
              }
          }
          return out;
      }
      ```

      ```ts file=<rootDir>/packages/sdk/examples/asr/parakeet-sortformer.ts title="parakeet-sortformer.ts" lineNumbers
      /**
       * Parakeet Sortformer diarization + TDT transcription pipeline.
       *
       * Usage:
       *   npx tsx examples/asr/parakeet-sortformer.ts <wav-file> [sortformer-gguf]
       *
       * Two-step flow: Sortformer v2.1 diarizes the audio, then TDT transcribes each
       * speaker segment. Defaults to registry GGUFs. For live streaming + AOSC, see
       * `parakeet-sortformer-streaming.ts`.
       *
       * Audio should be 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM in a WAV container. A multi-speaker
       * sample is in the QVAC source repo but not the published npm package:
       *   https://github.com/tetherto/qvac/blob/main/packages/sdk/examples/audio/diarization-sample-16k.wav
       */
      import {
        loadModel,
        unloadModel,
        transcribe,
        PARAKEET_TDT_0_6B_V3_Q8_0,
        PARAKEET_SORTFORMER_4SPK_V2_1_Q8_0
      } from '@qvac/sdk'
      import { join } from 'path'
      import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'fs'
      import { tmpdir } from 'os'

      const args = process.argv.slice(2)

      if (!args[0]) {
        console.error('Usage: npx tsx examples/asr/parakeet-sortformer.ts <wav-file> [sortformer-gguf]')
        console.error('\nIf the model path is omitted, defaults to the registry model.')
        process.exit(1)
      }

      const audioFilePath = args[0]
      const sortformerSrc = args[1] ?? PARAKEET_SORTFORMER_4SPK_V2_1_Q8_0

      try {
        // â”€â”€ Step 1: Diarize with Sortformer â”€â”€

        const sfModelId = await loadModel({
          modelSrc: sortformerSrc,
          modelType: 'parakeet-transcription'
        })

        const diarization = await transcribe({
          modelId: sfModelId,
          audioChunk: audioFilePath
        })
        await unloadModel({ modelId: sfModelId })

        const segments = parseDiarization(diarization)

        // â”€â”€ Step 2: Transcribe each segment with TDT â”€â”€

        const tdtModelId = await loadModel({
          modelSrc: PARAKEET_TDT_0_6B_V3_Q8_0
        })

        const pcm = readPcm(audioFilePath)
        const sliceDir = join(tmpdir(), `qvac-diarize-${Date.now()}`)
        mkdirSync(sliceDir, { recursive: true })

        const results: {
          speaker: number
          start: number
          end: number
          text: string
        }[] = []

        for (let i = 0; i < segments.length; i++) {
          const seg = segments[i]!
          const slicePath = join(sliceDir, `seg-${i}.wav`)

          if (!writeWavSlice(pcm, seg.start, seg.end, slicePath)) {
            results.push({ ...seg, text: '[No speech detected]' })
            continue
          }

          const text = await transcribe({
            modelId: tdtModelId,
            audioChunk: slicePath
          })
          results.push({ ...seg, text: text.trim() || '[No speech detected]' })
        }

        await unloadModel({ modelId: tdtModelId })

        // â”€â”€ Step 3: Merge consecutive same-speaker segments and print â”€â”€

        const merged = mergeSpeakers(results)

        console.log('\nâ–¸ Diarized transcription')
        for (const entry of merged) {
          console.log(`Speaker ${entry.speaker} (${entry.start.toFixed(2)}s - ${entry.end.toFixed(2)}s):`)
          console.log(`  ${entry.text}\n`)
        }
        console.log('â–¸ Done')
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('âœ–', error)
        process.exit(1)
      }

      // â”€â”€ Helpers â”€â”€

      function parseDiarization(text: string) {
        const segs: { speaker: number; start: number; end: number }[] = []
        for (const line of text.split('\n')) {
          const m = line.match(/Speaker (\d+): ([\d.]+)s - ([\d.]+)s/)
          if (m) segs.push({ speaker: +m[1]!, start: +m[2]!, end: +m[3]! })
        }
        return segs.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start)
      }

      function readPcm(wavPath: string): Buffer {
        const buf = readFileSync(wavPath)
        const dataOffset = buf.indexOf('data') + 4
        return buf.subarray(dataOffset + 4, dataOffset + 4 + buf.readUInt32LE(dataOffset))
      }

      function writeWavSlice(pcm: Buffer, startSec: number, endSec: number, outPath: string): boolean {
        const SR = 16000
        const BPS = 2
        const startByte = Math.floor(startSec * SR) * BPS
        const endByte = Math.min(Math.ceil(endSec * SR) * BPS, pcm.length)
        if (startByte >= endByte) return false

        const slice = pcm.subarray(startByte, endByte)
        const hdr = Buffer.alloc(44)
        hdr.write('RIFF', 0)
        hdr.writeUInt32LE(36 + slice.length, 4)
        hdr.write('WAVEfmt ', 8)
        hdr.writeUInt32LE(16, 16)
        hdr.writeUInt16LE(1, 20)
        hdr.writeUInt16LE(1, 22)
        hdr.writeUInt32LE(SR, 24)
        hdr.writeUInt32LE(SR * BPS, 28)
        hdr.writeUInt16LE(BPS, 32)
        hdr.writeUInt16LE(16, 34)
        hdr.write('data', 36)
        hdr.writeUInt32LE(slice.length, 40)

        writeFileSync(outPath, Buffer.concat([hdr, slice]))
        return true
      }

      function mergeSpeakers<T extends { speaker: number; start: number; end: number; text: string }>(
        entries: T[]
      ): T[] {
        const out: T[] = []
        for (const e of entries) {
          const last = out[out.length - 1]
          if (last && last.speaker === e.speaker) {
            last.text += ' ' + e.text
            last.end = e.end
          } else {
            out.push({ ...e })
          }
        }
        return out
      }
      ```
